claim.en: ## High-frequency loss and current sharing
claim.zh-CN: ## 高频损耗与电流分配

claim.en: Litz wire controls high-frequency current through strand insulation and longitudinal transposition. Strand diameter sets the local skin-effect scale, neighboring conductors and the return shape proximity fields, and common terminals couple the complex strand currents. A structural comparison therefore requires both an electromagnetic model and consistent definitions of copper area, axial length, and terminal conditions.
claim.zh-CN: Litz 线通过细股绝缘与沿程换位调节高频电流分布，其损耗同时受单股趋肤、股间磁耦合和端部连接影响。单股直径描述局部电流渗透的尺度，沿程位置决定各股所经历的磁场，共同端接则约束复电流的整体分配。因此，评价一种结构需要把几何参数、场路条件与可比较的损耗量联系起来，并估计相关数值不确定性。

claim.en: Discrete-transposition modeling with two-dimensional FEM (DTM) [@P01] connects strand-position permutations to cross-sectional fields. Its extension to nonideal compound transposition (iDTM) [@N01] treats hierarchical and subbundle effects. Improved segmented equivalent circuits [@P02], FEM–PEEC coupling [@P03], and quasi-two-dimensional multiconductor formulations [@P04] use different reductions of field and circuit behavior. Continuum models [@P05] and complex-permeability homogenization [@P09] reduce the cost of winding calculations. Their results must be interpreted through the fields, current constraints, and boundary conditions retained by each method.
claim.zh-CN: 现有研究从不同尺度处理这一问题。离散换位模型 DTM [@P01] 将截面二维有限元与股线位置置换结合，改进模型 iDTM [@N01] 进一步描述复合 Litz 的非理想换位；分段等效电路 iSEC [@P02] 则在指定绕组和分层假设下求解损耗。FEM–PEEC 耦合 [@P03] 与准二维多导体模型 [@P04] 提供了场量和电路量共同求解的途径。连续体模型 [@P05] 及复磁导率均匀化 [@P09] 以平均量降低绕组计算成本。这些方法在空间分辨率、换位表示和端接处理上各有侧重，结果的比较因而首先取决于模型是否描述同一物理对象与激励。

claim.en: This work connects three levels through reviewable numerical verification: round-wire analysis, multistrand two-dimensional common-terminal coupling, and finite-length longitudinal PEEC. The analytical solution supplies an internal-impedance reference; the two-dimensional model solves both intrastand fields and complex strand currents; the longitudinal model examines the influence of the finite-length kernel and integration settings on resistance. Traditional multilevel Litz provides the baseline for subsequent structural comparisons, while cross-layer paths are candidate geometries to be evaluated. The numerical conclusions apply to the degrees of freedom and boundary conditions retained at each level.
claim.zh-CN: 本文以可复核的数值验证为目标，连接单圆线解析、多股二维共端场路和有限长度纵向 PEEC 三个层次。解析解提供内部阻抗基准；二维模型同时求解股内场与股间复电流；纵向模型用于考察有限长度核及积分设置对电阻的影响。传统多级 Litz 是后续结构比较的基线，跨层路径属于待评价的候选几何。本文给出的数值结论限于各层实际包含的自由度和边界条件。

claim.en: ## Research questions and contributions
claim.zh-CN: ## 研究问题与本文工作

claim.en: This paper addresses three related questions: whether independent discretizations reproduce round-wire skin current and loss; how uniform complex strand currents can be characterized under common terminal voltage; and how finite-length longitudinal PEEC resistance responds to length, integration, and cross-sectional discretization. We organize verification by observable, derive a current-sharing condition for a specified linear field–circuit model, and report quantitative results for a 640-strand two-dimensional case and longitudinal cases with 1264 and 5024 degrees of freedom. Supplementary three-dimensional imposed-field, potential-diagnostic, and interface cases identify the implementation's applicability and the conditions required for further research.
claim.zh-CN: 本文回答三个相互关联的问题：独立离散方法能否复现单圆线的趋肤电流和损耗；共同端电压下，怎样判断各股复电流是否均匀；有限长度纵向 PEEC 的电阻对长度、积分和横向离散有多大敏感性。相应地，本文建立按观测量组织的验证关系，推导指定线性场路模型的均流条件，并给出 640 股二维算例及 1264、5024 自由度纵向算例的定量结果。三维外场算例、场势诊断和接口验证作为补充材料，用于说明现有实现的适用范围与进一步研究所需的条件。

claim.en: ## Operating conditions and comparison quantities
claim.zh-CN: ## 工况与比较量

claim.en: Calculations use SI units, the exp(jωt) time convention, and RMS phasors. Copper at 20 °C has conductivity σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m and relative permeability μr=1. The principal transport condition is 200 kHz and 20 A RMS, with zero independent imposed field. Strands are insulated along their lengths and connected in parallel at their ends. Resistance and loss are normalized by axial length; actual strand arc lengths enter copper volume and DC resistance separately. Finite-segment terminal voltage is measured in V, while the two-dimensional axial terminal field is measured in V/m, with the chosen axial length connecting the two.
claim.zh-CN: 计算采用 SI 单位、exp(jωt) 时间约定和 RMS 相量。材料为 20 ℃ 铜，电导率 σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m，相对磁导率 μr=1；主输运工况为 200 kHz、20 A RMS，独立外加场为零。股线沿途绝缘、端部并联。电阻和损耗按轴向长度归一化，股线的实际弧长另行计入铜体积与直流电阻。有限段端电压的单位为 V，二维轴向端场的单位为 V/m，二者通过所采用的轴向长度建立联系。

claim.en: The original Q1 round wire, 2 mm in diameter, provides an analytical calibration. Its copper area is 3.141593 mm² and its mean DC current density at 20 A is 6.366198 A/mm², exceeding the specified limit of 4 A/mm². Q2 therefore requires at least 5 mm² copper cross-section. For 640 strands of copper diameter 0.100 mm, the ideal circular area is 5.026548 mm². Each strand in the two-dimensional model is represented by a 64-sided polygon, giving an actual copper area of {{metric:coax_area}} mm². Equal-copper comparisons use this discrete area so that the electromagnetic reference incorporates the same geometric approximation.
claim.zh-CN: 原题 Q1 的直径 2 mm 圆线用于解析校准。其铜面积为 3.141593 mm²，在 20 A 下的平均直流电流密度为 6.366198 A/mm²，超过题设 4 A/mm² 限值。满足该限值的 Q2 需至少 5 mm² 铜截面。640 股、单股铜径 0.100 mm 的理想圆面积为 5.026548 mm²，二维模型以 64 边形表示每股，实际铜面积为 {{metric:coax_area}} mm²。等铜比较使用实际离散面积，使几何近似的影响与电磁结果具有一致的参照。

claim.en: For unequal strand arc lengths, parallel conductances determine DC resistance and the sum of strand area–length products determines copper volume, as in {{eqref:E01}}. We examine absolute AC resistance, Rac/Rdc, copper loss, and complex current sharing. Equation {{eqref:E02}} gives RMS Joule loss and defines resistance from copper dissipation under pure transport excitation. The supplementary RT0 case uses an independent imposed field and zero net transport, so its absorbed power is reported separately as imposed-field loss.
claim.zh-CN: 各股具有不同弧长时，直流电阻由并联电导求得，铜体积由各股面积与弧长乘积相加，见 {{eqref:E01}}。本文同时考察绝对交流电阻、Rac/Rdc、铜损耗与复电流分配。RMS 相量下的焦耳损耗见 {{eqref:E02}}；该式中电阻由纯输运工况的铜损耗定义。补充材料的 RT0 算例采用独立外场和零净输运，其吸收功率以外场损耗单独报告。

claim.en: ## Maxwell
claim.zh-CN: ## 磁准静态物理约定

claim.en: In the magnetoquasistatic approximation, conduction dominates displacement current and charge continuity gives ∇·J=0. With exp(jωt), Faraday’s law is ∇×E=−jωB and Ohm’s law is J=σE. Materials, excitation, return, and boundary conditions define a boundary-value problem. Mapping its comparable observables to the next discretization establishes the verification sequence used here.
claim.zh-CN: 在磁准静态近似下，位移电流相对于导电电流忽略，电荷连续性给出 ∇·J=0。采用 exp(jωt) 后，法拉第定律为 ∇×E=−jωB，欧姆关系为 J=σE。通过材料、激励、回流和边界共同定义一个边值问题，再将可比较的观测量映射到下一层离散问题，构成本文的验证顺序。

claim.en: ## Model hierarchy and verification relationships
claim.zh-CN: ## 模型层级与验证关系

claim.en: The models are related as shown in {{figref:model_hierarchy}}. Analytical round-wire and two-dimensional diffusion models share the long, straight internal-field problem, allowing radial current and internal resistance to be compared. The two-dimensional common-terminal model additionally retains intrastand distributions, interstrand currents, and a controlled return, supporting field–circuit analysis of a specified cross-section. Longitudinal PEEC uses a finite-length partial-inductance kernel to examine the effect of length on axial currents. The three-component RT0 model uses imposed-field absorption in a cuboid to test three-dimensional continuity and discrete operators. Transposition paths and actual end regions require corresponding longitudinal or transverse degrees of freedom in subsequent structural research.
claim.zh-CN: 各模型的关系如 {{figref:model_hierarchy}} 所示。解析圆线与二维扩散模型具有共同的长直内场问题，可比较径向电流和内部电阻。二维共端模型进一步保留股内分布、股间电流与受控回流，适合研究指定截面的场路耦合。纵向 PEEC 采用有限长度部分电感核，可检查长度对轴向电流解的影响。三分量 RT0 模型则以长方体外场吸收为算例，检验三维电流连续性与离散算子。换位路径和实际端区需要相应的沿程或横向自由度，属于后续三维结构研究的范围。

claim.en: Verification comprises equation solution, physical constraints, power consistency, and parameter sensitivity. Targets are 10⁻⁸ for true linear residuals, common-terminal conditions, and total complex current; 0.1% for independent power balance; and 1% for changes in mesh, segmentation, boundary, and length. Analytical reference values and current/power integrals use thresholds of 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻⁸, respectively. The RT0 GMRES true-residual target is 10⁻¹¹, its quadrature-sensitivity target is 0.1%, and same-model CPU/GPU matrix and complex-current comparisons use 10⁻¹⁰.
claim.zh-CN: 验证分为方程求解、物理约束、功率一致性和参数敏感性四部分。真实线性残差、共同端条件与总复电流误差的目标为 10⁻⁸，独立功率平衡为 0.1%，网格、分段、边界及长度变化的比较目标为 1%。解析参考与电流、功率积分分别使用 10⁻⁶ 和 10⁻⁸ 门槛。RT0 的 GMRES 真残差目标为 10⁻¹¹，积分敏感性为 0.1%；同模型 CPU/GPU 矩阵与复电流的对照门槛为 10⁻¹⁰。

claim.en: These checks answer different questions. Residuals measure the accuracy of the discrete-system solution, power balance tests field–circuit and postprocessing consistency, and parameter sensitivity describes changes over specified perturbations. Model omissions, boundary approximations, and experimental deviations require their own evidence. We therefore distinguish numerical checks from physical applicability and interpret finite sensitivity studies as local validation rather than a common upper bound on total model error.
claim.zh-CN: 这些检查回答不同的问题。残差衡量离散系统的求解精度，功率平衡检查场路与后处理的一致性，参数敏感性表征指定扰动范围内的变化。模型遗漏、边界近似及实验偏差需要相应的独立证据。因此，下文分别说明数值检查结果及其物理适用范围，并把有限敏感性结果作为局部验证，而非全模型误差的统一上界。

claim.en: ## Round-wire radial equation and normalization
claim.zh-CN: ## 圆线径向方程与归一化

claim.en: Axial current inside a long straight round wire satisfies (1/r)d(r dJz/dr)/dr=κ²Jz. Finiteness at the axis selects I₀(κr), and the total complex-current constraint together with ∫₀ᵃrI₀(κr)dr=aI₁(κa)/κ fixes its coefficient. Surface axial electric field divided by total current gives internal impedance per unit length. An independent Joule integral of current density checks the relationship between its real part and loss. The derivation uses the same RMS phasors as the main text.
claim.zh-CN: 长直圆线内部的轴向电流满足 (1/r)d(r dJz/dr)/dr=κ²Jz。轴心有限性确定径向函数为 I₀(κr)，总复电流约束与积分关系 ∫₀ᵃrI₀(κr)dr=aI₁(κa)/κ 确定其系数。表面轴向电场与总电流之比给出单位长度内部阻抗；对电流密度独立执行焦耳积分，可核对阻抗实部与损耗之间的关系。推导采用与正文一致的 RMS 相量。

claim.en: ## Round-wire internal-field calibration
claim.zh-CN: ## 单圆线内部场校准

claim.en: The radial current and internal impedance of a long straight round wire follow {{eqref:E03}}. At 200 kHz, the skin depth δ={{metric:skin_depth}} mm is approximately 0.148 times the radius, and current concentrates near the surface. DC resistance is {{metric:q1_rdc}} mΩ/m, AC resistance is {{metric:q1_rac}} mΩ/m, and Rac/Rdc=3.64720, giving a loss of {{metric:q1_loss}} W/m. The radial profiles and cross-sectional magnitude appear in {{figref:q1_profile}} and {{figref:q1_cross_section}}. Radial phase is continuously unwrapped, showing the amplitude attenuation and phase change associated with skin diffusion. The analytical impedance concerns the conductor's internal field.
claim.zh-CN: 长直圆线的径向电流与内部阻抗采用 {{eqref:E03}}。200 kHz 下趋肤深度 δ={{metric:skin_depth}} mm，约为圆线半径的 0.148，电流集中于表层。直流电阻为 {{metric:q1_rdc}} mΩ/m，交流电阻为 {{metric:q1_rac}} mΩ/m，Rac/Rdc=3.64720，对应损耗 {{metric:q1_loss}} W/m。径向曲线与截面幅值分别见 {{figref:q1_profile}} 和 {{figref:q1_cross_section}}。相位沿半径连续展开，显示了趋肤扩散同时引起的幅值衰减和相位变化；解析阻抗的范围为导体内部场。

claim.en: Independent two-dimensional disk diffusion uses three meshes with 353, 1389, and 5573 nodes, normalized by total complex current. With refinement, relative Rac error against analysis decreases from 7.05×10⁻³ to 2.30×10⁻⁴ and finally 1.79×10⁻⁶. The finest-grid relative power-integral difference is 3.07×10⁻⁶, as shown in {{figref:q1_fem_error}}. These results verify discretization, normalization, and power postprocessing for the isolated round-wire internal-field problem. The cross-sectional illustration uses linear interpolation of analytical radial samples and an axisymmetric mapping; subsequent multistrand models use their actual conductor field solutions.
claim.zh-CN: 独立二维圆盘扩散使用 353、1389、5573 节点的三档网格，并按总复电流归一化。随着网格细化，Rac 解析相对误差由 7.05×10⁻³ 降至 2.30×10⁻⁴，最终为 1.79×10⁻⁶；最细档功率积分相对差为 3.07×10⁻⁶，见 {{figref:q1_fem_error}}。这组结果验证了孤立圆线内场问题的离散、归一化与功率后处理。截面图通过径向解析样本的线性插值和轴对称映射得到，后续多股模型则使用其实际导体场解。

title.zh-CN: 多股共端场路与均流判据
title.en: Multistrand Common-Terminal Circuits and Sharing Criterion

claim.en: ## Common-terminal coupling and uniform complex currents
claim.zh-CN: ## 共端场路与复电流均流条件

claim.en: The common endpoints, strand branches, and return are related in {{figref:common_terminal}}. Let Z be the coupled impedance matrix of a specified linear model, e the independently induced voltage, i the complex strand currents, and V the common terminal voltage. The port equation Zi+e=V1 and total-current constraint 1ᵀi=It form {{eqref:E04}}. Solving the augmented system yields both magnitude and phase; It/N serves as a reference for the resulting current distribution.
claim.zh-CN: 共同端点、股线支路与回流的关系见 {{figref:common_terminal}}。令 Z 为指定线性模型的耦合阻抗矩阵，e 为独立外场引起的感应项，i 为各股复电流，V 为公共端电压。端口方程 Z i+e=V1 与总电流条件 1ᵀi=It 共同构成 {{eqref:E04}}。求解该增广系统可同时得到幅值和相位，等流值 It/N 用于比较求得的电流分布。

claim.en: When the augmented system has a unique solution, substitution of i=(It/N)1 shows that uniform currents exist if and only if every component of (It/N)Z1+e is equal. Projecting this vector onto the subspace orthogonal to 1 gives {{eqref:E05}}. Without an independent imposed field, the condition reduces to equal row sums of Z; with an imposed field, the induced term also determines current sharing. This necessary and sufficient condition applies to the selected impedance model and terminal conditions, expressing the effect of transposition through changes in coupling and induced voltages.
claim.zh-CN: 在增广系统具有唯一解时，令 i=(It/N)1 可知：等流解存在，当且仅当向量 (It/N)Z1+e 的所有分量相同。将该向量投影到与 1 正交的子空间，便得到 {{eqref:E05}}。无独立外场时，条件简化为 Z 的各行和相同；存在外场时，感应项也参与决定均流。该判据给出了所选阻抗模型与端接条件下的充要条件，便于将几何换位的作用具体落实到耦合矩阵及感应项的变化上。

claim.en: The two-dimensional common-terminal FEM solves the shared axial terminal field jointly with Az degrees of freedom. In conductors, Jz=σ(v−u), where both v and the saved variable u are expressed in V/m; the return conductor uses its corresponding terminal field. Current and loss are integrated on material-tagged linear triangles after coordinates are converted from mm to m. Strand currents, bundle loss, return loss, and copper area are independently compared with the original field–circuit results, treating air and conductor regions separately.
claim.zh-CN: 二维共端 FEM 将公共轴向端场与 Az 自由度联合求解。导体内按 Jz=σ(v−u) 恢复电流密度，其中 v 与保存变量 u 均以 V/m 表示，回流导体使用相应的端场。电流和损耗由带材料标记的线性三角形积分，坐标由 mm 转换为 m 后计算面积。由此得到的逐股复电流、束内损耗、回流损耗及铜面积，与原始场路结果独立核对；空气区域与各导体区域分别处理。

claim.en: ## Derivation of the uniform complex-current condition
claim.zh-CN: ## 复电流均流条件的推导

claim.en: If a uniform-current solution exists, substituting i=(It/N)1 into the port equation makes all components of (It/N)Z1+e equal, establishing necessity of the projection condition. Conversely, when the projection condition holds, this vector equals a scalar V times 1. The uniform-current vector then satisfies both the port equation and the total-current constraint; uniqueness of the augmented solution makes it the actual solution, establishing sufficiency. Numerical results use sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| for normalized RMS complex-current deviation and show individual magnitudes and phases.
claim.zh-CN: 若等流解存在，将 i=(It/N)1 代入端口方程，即得向量 (It/N)Z1+e 的全部分量相同，投影条件因而必要。反之，若投影条件成立，该向量可写为某一标量 V 与 1 的乘积，等流向量同时满足端口方程和总电流约束；在增广系统解唯一时，它即为实际解，条件因而充分。数值结果以 sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| 表示归一化复电流 RMS 偏差，并同时展示逐股幅值与相位。

claim.en: ## Common-terminal currents and loss in a 640-strand straight bundle
claim.zh-CN: ## 640 股直束的共端电流与损耗

claim.en: Three meshes and variations of return distance and exterior domain complete 23 checks. The final mesh refinement changes Rac by 0.011902%; return-distance and exterior-domain changes are 0.000495% and 0.000270%, respectively, as shown in {{figref:coax640_mesh}}. These changes remain below the 1% comparison target over the tested perturbations, supporting numerical stability of the specified two-dimensional common-terminal result. Its applicability is a straight two-dimensional bundle with a controlled return; finite end regions and longitudinal coupling in actual wound structures require further verification.
claim.zh-CN: 三档网格以及回流距离、外域变化共完成 23 项检查。末次网格细化的 Rac 变化为 0.011902%，回流距离与外域变化分别为 0.000495% 和 0.000270%，见 {{figref:coax640_mesh}}。在已检查的扰动范围内，这些变化均小于 1% 比较目标，支持指定二维共端模型结果的数值稳定性。其适用对象为受控回流下的二维直束，实际绕制结构的有限端区与沿程耦合仍需进一步验证。

claim.en: {{figref:coax640_currents}} shows current magnitude and phase by physical strand identity, with It/N as the equal-current reference. Magnitude and phase jointly determine each strand's contribution to total transport current, so current sharing is evaluated using complex currents. {{figref:coax640_fields}} gives the corresponding cross-sectional fields, connecting strand statistics with spatial position. In this axially invariant straight bundle, the skin-effect scale within each fine strand coexists with collective current redistribution caused by magnetic coupling across the bundle. Longitudinal transposition requires a separate representation of position changes.
claim.zh-CN: {{figref:coax640_currents}} 按物理股线身份展示电流幅值和相位，It/N 为等流参照。幅值差异与相位差共同决定各股对总输运电流的贡献，因此均流程度应根据复电流评价。{{figref:coax640_fields}} 给出相应的截面场分布，可将逐股统计与空间位置联系起来。对于这一沿轴向保持截面的直束，细股自身的趋肤尺度与束内磁耦合造成的集体电流分配同时存在；沿程换位的影响需另行引入位置变化。

claim.en: ## Interpretation
claim.zh-CN: ## 束内与回流能量

claim.en: The 640-strand section distinguishes the skin-effect scale of an individual fine strand from collective current redistribution in the bundle. Inner and outer strands experience different magnetic coupling; under a common terminal field, this difference appears in current magnitude and phase. DC area supplies a reference for copper utilization, the bundle Joule integral gives transport loss, and the separate return integral describes energy allocation across the complete field–circuit system.
claim.zh-CN: 640 股截面结果说明了细股自身趋肤尺度与束内集体电流分配之间的区别。外层与内层股线具有不同的磁耦合环境，共同端电压使这种差异表现为复电流的幅值和相位变化。此时直流面积给出铜利用率的基准，束内焦耳积分给出输运损耗，而回流的单独积分解释完整场路的能量分配。

claim.en: The actual copper cross-section of the two-dimensional 640-strand model is {{metric:coax_area}} mm². Bundle AC resistance is {{metric:coax_rac}} mΩ per axial metre, bundle loss is {{metric:coax_bundle_loss}} W per axial metre, and return loss is {{metric:coax_return_loss}} W per axial metre. Separate integration identifies dissipation in the bundle and return. The common axial terminal field is {{metric:coax_voltage_re}}+j({{metric:coax_voltage_im}}) V/m. Complex strand currents sum to 20 A RMS, while their normalized RMS complex-current deviation is {{metric:coax_spread}}, demonstrating substantial interstrand differences in this common-terminal straight bundle.
claim.zh-CN: 640 股二维模型的实际铜截面为 {{metric:coax_area}} mm²。束内交流电阻为 {{metric:coax_rac}} mΩ/轴向m，束内损耗为 {{metric:coax_bundle_loss}} W/轴向m，回流损耗为 {{metric:coax_return_loss}} W/轴向m；分开积分明确了导体束与回流各自的热耗散。共同端轴向电场为 {{metric:coax_voltage_re}}+j({{metric:coax_voltage_im}}) V/m。各股复电流之和恢复 20 A RMS，而归一化复电流 RMS 偏差为 {{metric:coax_spread}}，表明该共端直束存在显著的股间电流差异。

claim.en: ## Geometry sampling and discrete transposition
claim.zh-CN: ## 几何采样与离散换位

claim.en: {{figref:geometry_comparison}} shows straight, single-level, traditional multilevel and cross-layer centerlines. The geometry records preserve strand identity, periodicity, clearance, curvature, actual arc length and copper volume. Axial sampling at 400, 800 and 1600 points and 60 checks support sampling consistency for these quantities. The illustrated 24-strand structure with a copper diameter of 0.100 mm has a nominal copper area of approximately 0.1885 mm² and demonstrates geometry construction. A structure meeting the minimum 5 mm² copper area requires separate construction and verification. Three-dimensional views reveal spatial paths; the corresponding field-circuit model evaluates electromagnetic performance.
claim.zh-CN: {{figref:geometry_comparison}} 展示直束、单级、传统多级与跨层中心线。几何记录包括股线身份、周期、间隙、曲率、实际弧长和铜体积，400、800、1600 轴向采样及 60 项检查支持这些量的采样一致性。所示 24 股、0.100 mm 铜径结构的名义铜面积约为 0.1885 mm²，用于说明几何构造；满足至少 5 mm² 铜面积的结构需另行建立并验证。三维视角用于观察空间路径，电磁性能由相应场路模型评价。

claim.en: The current DTM/iDTM demonstration uses the additive discrete blocks in {{eqref:E06}}. For the same weighted impedance blocks, their sum is invariant to ordering; this implementation therefore checks identity mappings and circuit accumulation of the specified blocks. Comparing actual transposition paths additionally requires longitudinal position changes, noncommuting relationships between levels, local fields, and terminal conditions. These assumptions determine comparability with the literature [@P01; @N01].
claim.zh-CN: 当前 DTM/iDTM 演示采用 {{eqref:E06}} 的加性离散块。对于同一组带权阻抗块，求和结果对排列顺序保持不变，因此该实现可验证身份映射和给定块的电路叠加。真实换位路径的比较还需考虑位置随长度的变化、层级间的非交换关系、局部场及端接条件。与文献 [@P01; @N01] 对照时，这些具体假设决定两种实现具有多大可比性。

claim.en: ## Mapping strand identity to cross-sectional position
claim.zh-CN: ## 股线身份与截面位置的变换

claim.en: Let Ps map fixed physical strand identities to spatial positions in cross-section s. Local currents are Ps i, and local voltages transformed back to identity coordinates are PsᵀZsPs i. Summing in series with segment lengths Δzs gives {{eqref:E06}}. Position and identity are retained separately; K, 2K, and 4K segmentation comparisons use the same trajectory and strands. Periodicity, clearance, and curvature check the paths, while actual arc lengths and copper volume quantify material use.
claim.zh-CN: 令 Ps 将固定物理股线身份映射到第 s 个截面的空间位置，则局部电流为 Ps i，转换回身份坐标的局部电压为 PsᵀZsPs i。按段长 Δzs 串联相加得到 {{eqref:E06}}。在这一表示中，位置与身份分别保存，K、2K、4K 的分段比较使用同一轨迹和同一组股线。周期、间隙与曲率用于检查轨迹，实际弧长和铜体积用于比较材料用量。

claim.en: ## Geometry Sampling and Equal-Copper Checks
claim.zh-CN: ## 几何采样与等铜检查

claim.en: Trajectory recovery preserves physical strand IDs instead of renaming strands by cross-sectional order. Period checks distinguish position closure from identity permutation; gap and curvature checks use physical units, and arc length is integrated from sampled paths and compared with doubled sampling. Copper volume and DC resistance use actual strand lengths; the axial length is not substituted for every helical branch. Local cropping and display subsampling are recorded under the publication run, while complete original centerlines remain available.
claim.zh-CN: 轨迹恢复保留物理股线 ID，不按截面排序重新命名。周期检查应分别看位置闭合和身份置换；间隙与曲率检查使用真实单位，弧长由路径采样积分并与加倍采样比较。铜体积与直流电阻以实际股长进入计算，不能把轴向长度直接用于所有螺旋支路。成稿展示的局部截取和绘图抽样在新运行号下记录，原完整中心线继续保留。

claim.en: Equal-copper comparisons identify circular nominal area, discretized actual area, and the outer envelope occupied by insulation. At the same nominal area, longer arc length increases copper volume per axial metre and the resistive path length. Geometric complexity itself supplies no evidence of electromagnetic improvement. The 640-strand candidate trajectories and 7/24-strand construction demonstrations serve different scales, and public materials should retain that distinction.
claim.zh-CN: 等铜对照应注明圆形名义面积、离散实际面积和绝缘占据的外包络。相同名义面积下，较大的弧长会增加单位轴向长度铜体积和电阻路径长度；几何复杂度自身不产生电磁改善证据。640 股候选中心线与 7/24 股构造演示承担不同尺度任务，公开材料应保留这个区别。

claim.en: ## Finite-length longitudinal PEEC
claim.zh-CN: ## 有限长度纵向 PEEC

claim.en: Longitudinal PEEC divides the cross-section into volume filaments, each carrying an axial complex current density uniform along its length. Ohmic resistance and finite-volume partial inductance follow {{eqref:E08}}, forming Z=R+jωL before the common-port and total-current constraints in {{eqref:E04}} are applied. The counts 1264 and 5024 denote volume-filament degrees of freedom in a continuous conductor. Differences between their currents represent internal current concentration within the longitudinal basis.
claim.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 将导体截面离散为体积细丝，每条细丝内采用沿轴向、沿长度均匀的复电流密度。欧姆电阻与有限体积对的部分电感由 {{eqref:E08}} 给出，并形成 Z=R+jωL，随后按 {{eqref:E04}} 施加公共端口和总电流约束。1264 与 5024 表示体积细丝自由度；这些细丝是连续导体的离散单元。同一截面内各体积细丝的电流差异表示内部电流集中，所用基函数的范围为纵向电流。

claim.en: The longitudinal case has a nominal round-wire diameter of 2 mm. The m40 and m80 square filaments are 0.050 and 0.025 mm wide, giving actual cross-sectional areas of 3.16 and 3.14 mm². Sensitivity studies vary length, mutual integration, or self integration independently. The 1264-degree-of-freedom model uses one cross-section at lengths 0.16, 0.32, and 0.64 m. At fixed length, mutual quadrature order q is increased through 4, 6, and 8, while self-integration settings increase from 10/8 to 12/10. These pairs are AccuracyGoal and PrecisionGoal, the target absolute and relative precision digits. The 5024-degree-of-freedom model checks lengths 0.32 and 0.64 m and the same integration changes. Because the two cross-sectional discretizations have slightly different copper areas, each resistance is compared with its own equal-area Bessel reference; changes between discretizations include both discretization and area approximation.
claim.zh-CN: 纵向算例的名义圆线直径为 2 mm。m40 与 m80 的方形细丝宽度分别为 0.050 mm 和 0.025 mm，对应实际截面面积 3.16 mm² 和 3.14 mm²。敏感性试验分别改变长度、互项积分或自项积分设置。1264 自由度模型采用同一截面与 0.16、0.32、0.64 m 三档长度；固定长度后，将互项积分阶数 q 依次取为 4、6、8，自项精度从 10/8 提高至 12/10；两个数字依次表示自项数值积分的 AccuracyGoal 与 PrecisionGoal，即绝对精度和相对精度的目标位数。5024 自由度模型复核 0.32、0.64 m 长度及相同积分变化。两种截面离散的铜面积略有差异，因此各档电阻分别与自身等面积圆线的 Bessel 解比较；跨档变化同时包含离散和面积近似的影响。

claim.en: The partial-inductance kernel includes magnetic coupling around finite conductors, whereas the Bessel solution gives the internal impedance of a long straight round wire. We compare their dissipative component Rac while retaining length and area conditions. The length study measures sensitivity of the current kernel and longitudinal basis. Transverse loops, curved strands, and actual end-current redistribution require extended degrees of freedom. The connection to FEM–PEEC coupling [@P03] lies in a joint field–circuit description; excitation, return, and field-feedback choices must be compared for each implementation.
claim.zh-CN: 部分电感核包含有限导体周围的磁耦合，圆线 Bessel 解给出长直导体的内部阻抗。两者在本文中以耗散分量 Rac 进行比较，同时保留长度和面积条件。长度试验衡量当前核与纵向基函数的敏感性；横向环流、曲线股线和真实端部电流重分布需通过扩展自由度研究。与 FEM–PEEC 耦合方法 [@P03] 的联系在于场路联合描述，具体的激励、回流和场反馈方式仍应按各实现分别比较。

claim.en: ## Longitudinal filament basis and kernel integration
claim.zh-CN: ## 纵向细丝基函数与核积分

claim.en: Within volume filament α, current density is constant at iα/Aα and directed axially. Volume integration of vector potential gives the induced electric field in a testing filament; integration along its length yields a symmetric partial-inductance matrix. Coincident points produce an integrable self-term singularity treated with dedicated precision settings, while mutual terms use a separate quadrature order. Ohmic resistance and jωL form the coupled matrix, solved jointly with common terminal voltage and total current. The basis determines the current directions represented by this model.
claim.zh-CN: 第 α 条体积细丝中的电流密度取为常量 iα/Aα，方向沿轴向。由矢势体积积分得到测试细丝内的感应电场，再沿长度积分，可得对称部分电感矩阵。自项在重合点具有可积奇性，使用专门的自项精度控制；互项采用独立积分阶数。欧姆电阻与 jωL 组成耦合矩阵，并与公共端电压和总电流约束联合求解。所用基函数决定了这一模型能够表示的电流方向。

claim.en: ## Length and integration sensitivity of longitudinal PEEC
claim.zh-CN: ## 纵向 PEEC 的长度和积分敏感性

claim.en: For the 1264-degree-of-freedom model, resistances at 0.16, 0.32, and 0.64 m are 19.8992, 19.9586, and 19.9885 mΩ per axial metre. Consecutive length changes are 0.298640% and 0.149482%. The 5024-degree-of-freedom model changes by 0.148730% from 0.32 to 0.64 m, as shown in {{figref:peec_length}}. Resistance changes decrease with increasing length, and all tested increments are below 1%. The sequence characterizes sensitivity over the 0.16–0.64 m interval.
claim.zh-CN: 1264 自由度模型在 0.16、0.32、0.64 m 的电阻分别为 19.8992、19.9586、19.9885 mΩ/轴向m，相邻长度变化为 0.298640% 和 0.149482%；5024 自由度模型的 0.32→0.64 m 变化为 0.148730%，见 {{figref:peec_length}}。长度增加时电阻变化减小，且已检查增量均低于 1%。该序列给出了 0.16–0.64 m 范围内的敏感性。

claim.en: At 5024 degrees of freedom, Lz=0.64 m, mutual order q=4, and self-integration settings 12/10, Rac={{metric:peec_rac}} mΩ per axial metre, Rac/Rdc=3.64472, and loss is 8.00510 W per axial metre. Resistance differs by 0.044582% from the equal-area Bessel reference for this discretization. {{figref:peec_cross_section}} reconstructs the cross-sectional current distribution from saved filament currents and square cells, showing surface concentration within the conductor. These degrees of freedom discretize a continuous conductor; their current variation has a different meaning from current sharing among insulated strands.
claim.zh-CN: 在 5024 自由度、Lz=0.64 m、互项 q=4、自项 12/10 时，Rac={{metric:peec_rac}} mΩ/轴向m，Rac/Rdc=3.64472，损耗为 8.00510 W/轴向m，与该档等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。{{figref:peec_cross_section}} 以保存的细丝电流和方形单元恢复截面电流分布，呈现导体内部的表层集中。这里的自由度属于连续导体离散，电流离散程度与前述绝缘股线间的均流指标具有不同含义。

claim.en: Results for mutual order q=4→6→8 and self settings 10/8→12/10 appear in {{figref:peec_sensitivity}}. Across both model sizes, the largest relative resistance change from mutual integration is 1.21×10⁻⁵ and the largest relative complex-current change is 1.60×10⁻⁵. Corresponding maxima for self integration are 6.75×10⁻¹¹ and 7.10×10⁻¹¹. Coarse-to-fine cross-sectional resistance changes at 0.32 and 0.64 m are 0.122127% and 0.121376%, respectively, and include changes in actual area. Thus integration settings have a smaller effect than length and cross-sectional discretization in these tests. Analytical references and sensitivities jointly support resistance calculation within the longitudinal model; actual end regions and transverse-current errors remain model-level research questions.
claim.zh-CN: 互项 q=4→6→8、自项 10/8→12/10 的结果见 {{figref:peec_sensitivity}}。两种规模中，互项变化所对应的最大电阻相对变化为 1.21×10⁻⁵，最大复电流相对变化为 1.60×10⁻⁵；自项变化的相应最大值为 6.75×10⁻¹¹ 和 7.10×10⁻¹¹。横向粗细离散在 0.32、0.64 m 下的电阻变化分别为 0.122127% 和 0.121376%，该比较同时涉及实际面积变化。由此，积分设置的影响在当前试验中小于长度和截面离散的影响。解析参照与敏感性结果共同支持纵向模型的电阻计算，真实端区及横向电流的误差仍属于模型层面的研究问题。

claim.zh-CN: 算例为 1×1×2 mm 均质铜长方体，频率 200 kHz，外加 Bz=1 mT RMS，净输运电流为零。三分量电流以面通量自由度表示，分别检查连续性、端口约束和外场功率。采用 q=14 积分时，8192、16000、27648 单元的损耗为 0.927463、0.933539、0.936927 mW；连续两次细化变化为 0.655090% 和 0.362916%，低于 1% 目标。末档提高至 q=18 后，损耗与复面通量的相对变化分别为 1.55×10⁻⁸ 和 1.39×10⁻⁸，低于 0.1% 积分目标，见 {{figref:rt0_spatial}}。

claim.en: Sections and vectors in {{figref:rt0_sections}} and {{figref:rt0_vectors}} are reconstructed from saved face fluxes. Cell-center current is obtained by averaging opposite-face fluxes and dividing by face area. Cell-average loss density uses the full local RT0 overlap integral and therefore includes within-cell variation. Arrows show the real current at zero phase with one common length scale; color represents the complex RMS norm. Section locations and vector samples follow the figure annotations, while volume integration uses all cells.
claim.zh-CN: 切面和矢量图分别见 {{figref:rt0_sections}}、{{figref:rt0_vectors}}，均由保存的面通量恢复。单元中心电流由相对两面的通量平均后除以面面积得到；单元平均损耗密度采用完整 RT0 局部重叠积分，因此包含单元内电流变化。箭头表示零相位时刻电流的实部，并采用统一长度比例，色标表示复 RMS 范数。切面位置和矢量抽样对应图中标注，体积分则使用全部单元。

claim.en: Each mesh records 35 GMRES iterations and meets the 10⁻¹¹ true-residual target. Spatial and quadrature comparisons jointly support the fixed-cuboid imposed-field result. Applicability has yet to extend to curved Litz masks, independently validated boundary fluxes, and actual transport terminals. The original q=18 summary's missing metrics and failure status, CSV-based postprocessing acceptance, and resource records for dense and matrix-free implementations are retained separately to preserve the relationship between solution and interpretation.
claim.zh-CN: 各档记录的 GMRES 迭代次数为 35，真残差满足 10⁻¹¹ 目标。空间与积分比较共同支持固定外场长方体的数值结论，适用范围尚未扩展至曲线 Litz 掩膜、独立边界通量验证和实际输运端接。q=18 原摘要中的缺失指标与失败状态、基于 CSV 的后处理验收，以及致密和矩阵自由实现的资源记录分别列入来源资料，以保持求解和数据解释的对应关系。

claim.en: The A–φ model recovers current using {{eqref:E07}} from saved A and actual gradients of φ. The three cylinder meshes contain 1683, 3672, and 9108 nodes; results appear in {{figref:aphi_gates}}. Radial J calibration meets its target on the finest mesh, while φ and gauge residuals fail on all three; the two coarser meshes also fail the J target. Manufactured-solution checks support correspondence between the tested equations and implementation, while physical cylinder calibration reveals field–potential consistency questions requiring further research.

claim.en: {{figref:aphi_preserved}} uses 128 explicitly identified nodal samples to display A, φ, J and the actual φ gradient at those locations. claim.en: ## Interpretation of current sharing and loss
claim.zh-CN: ## 对电流分配与损耗的解释

claim.en: The three result levels answer the questions posed in the introduction. Round-wire analysis and two-dimensional calibration establish a local skin-effect reference. The 640-strand results show that common terminal voltage permits substantially different complex strand currents, so strand size and interstrand uniformity require separate assessment. Longitudinal PEEC quantifies length and integration effects for its chosen basis. Structural comparisons consequently require control of actual copper area, return, terminals, and axial length, together with transposition-induced changes in coupling. Small discretization changes help identify numerically stable intervals; structural advantages must still be compared with relevant model errors and experimental uncertainty.
claim.zh-CN: 三个层次的结果分别回答了引言提出的问题。单圆线解析与二维校准建立局部趋肤基准；640 股结果显示，共同端电压允许各股具有显著不同的复电流，单股尺寸与股间均流应分别评价；纵向 PEEC 则量化了给定基函数下长度和积分的影响。由此，结构比较需要同时控制实际铜面积、回流、端接与轴向长度，并将换位所改变的耦合关系纳入场路求解。较小的离散变化有助于识别数值稳定区间，结构优势仍须与相关模型误差及实验不确定性共同比较。

claim.en: DTM and iDTM [@P01; @N01] provide a foundation for connecting longitudinal positions with cross-sectional fields. The common-terminal criterion expresses uniform-current requirements as an algebraic condition on the coupled matrix and induced terms, helping test whether a transposition approximation retains important differences. The segmented circuits of iSEC [@P02] and current constraints of quasi-two-dimensional methods [@P04] also show the need for joint field–circuit solution. Continuum and complex-permeability methods [@P05; @P09] lower macroscopic computational cost; strand currents and local losses require recovery consistent with their averaging assumptions. These works inform the methods, while our quantitative verification uses its own operating conditions, discretizations, and error records. Comparing experimental accuracy across methods requires a common case.
claim.zh-CN: DTM 与 iDTM [@P01; @N01] 为连接沿程位置和截面场提供了方法基础；本文的共端判据进一步把均流要求表述为耦合矩阵与感应项的代数条件，可用于检查给定换位近似是否保留关键差异。iSEC [@P02] 的分段电路和准二维方法 [@P04] 的电流约束，也体现了场路协同求解的必要性。连续体与复磁导率方法 [@P05; @P09] 适合降低宏观计算成本，逐股电流及局部损耗则需要与其平均化假设一致的恢复方法。上述文献提供方法参照；本文的定量验证采用自身工况、离散和误差记录，各方法的实验精度需在共同算例下比较。

claim.en: The main current uncertainty arises from differences between actual structures and simplified models. A straight two-dimensional bundle omits longitudinal transposition, and longitudinal PEEC omits transverse loops and actual end-current redistribution. The RT0 imposed-field case tests absorption in a fixed cuboid. Supplementary three-dimensional A–φ cylinder calibration retains failures in φ and gauge residuals, while the native three-dimensional Ansys interface has not produced an acceptable field solution. Temperature rise, insulation thickness, winding tolerances, and terminal contacts require thermal modeling and experimental assessment. These factors limit transfer of the present results to actual Litz performance.
claim.zh-CN: 现阶段的主要不确定性来自实际结构与简化模型之间的差异。二维直束省略沿程换位，纵向 PEEC 的基函数省略横向环流和真实端部重分布；RT0 外场算例检验的是固定长方体中的外场吸收。补充材料记录的三维 A–φ 圆柱校准仍有 φ 与规范残差未通过，Ansys 原生三维接口也尚未形成可接受场解。此外，温升、绝缘厚度、绕制公差与端接接触尚待热模型和实验评价。这些因素限定了当前结果向实际 Litz 性能的推广范围。

claim.en: ## Priorities for subsequent verification
claim.zh-CN: ## 后续验证的重点

claim.en: Subsequent work should first establish consistent boundaries, gauge treatment, terminal fields, and independent power integrals on manageable three-dimensional cylinders and small-strand structures. Actual terminals and transverse degrees of freedom can then be introduced before comparing traditional multilevel and cross-layer structures meeting the copper-area requirement. Experiments can measure complex impedance at matched frequency, temperature, return, and axial length while recording terminal resistance and geometric tolerances. This sequence separates numerical implementation errors, geometric approximations, and manufacturing deviations and supplies a comparable basis for structural ranking.
claim.zh-CN: 后续工作宜先在规模可控的三维圆柱和小股数结构上，使边界、规范、端场与独立功率积分形成一致验证；随后引入真实端接和横向自由度，再比较满足铜面积要求的传统多级与跨层结构。实验可在相同频率、温度、回流与轴向长度下测量复阻抗，同时记录端接电阻和几何公差。这样的顺序能将数值实现误差、几何近似及实际制造偏差逐步区分，并为结构性能排名提供可比较的依据。

claim.en: Under common phasor, length, and area definitions, this paper establishes verification relationships among round-wire analysis, two-dimensional common-terminal coupling, and finite-length longitudinal PEEC. The finest two-dimensional internal-field mesh has a relative analytical resistance error of 1.79×10⁻⁶. For parallel-connected strands, uniform currents are characterized by a zero differential-subspace projection of coupled impedance and imposed-field induction. Complex currents in the 640-strand straight bundle show that common terminals and fine subdivision must be assessed together with magnetic coupling. Longitudinal PEEC meets the relevant sensitivity targets for the tested lengths and integration settings; the final 5024-degree-of-freedom resistance differs by 0.044582% from its equal-area Bessel reference.
claim.zh-CN: 本文在统一相量、长度和面积定义下，建立了单圆线解析、二维共端场路与有限长度纵向 PEEC 的验证关系。二维内场解的最细网格电阻解析误差为 1.79×10⁻⁶。对端部并联的股线，等流条件可表述为耦合阻抗与外场感应项在差模子空间中的投影为零；640 股直束的复电流结果表明，共同端接与细股划分仍需结合磁耦合评价均流。纵向 PEEC 在已检查长度和积分设置下达到相应敏感性目标，5024 自由度末档电阻与本档等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。

claim.en: These results provide local-field references, common-terminal constraints, and finite-length computational benchmarks for research on actual transposition. RT0 imposed-field cases, CPU/GPU comparisons, and three-dimensional diagnostics further describe the implementations' ranges. Ranking actual Litz structures requires three-dimensional verification with end regions and transverse degrees of freedom, followed by thermal assessment and controlled experiments.
claim.zh-CN: 这些结果为后续真实换位结构研究提供了局部场基准、共端约束和有限长度计算的参照。RT0 外场、CPU/GPU 对照及三维诊断资料补充说明了各实现的范围。实际 Litz 结构的性能排序仍需具有端区和横向自由度的三维验证，并结合温升与受控实验完成评价。

claim.en: The accompanying automation workflows connect source identity, tool events, and scientific acceptance into research records that can be continued. Existing Codex, Wolfram, and Ansys cases verify execution and recovery for specified tasks. Broader client compatibility, repeated-task success rates, and operational-efficiency evaluation can be studied using a common task set.
claim.zh-CN: 与模型共同交付的自动化工作流将源码身份、工具事件和科学验收连接为可接续的研究记录。现有 Codex、Wolfram 与 Ansys 案例验证了指定任务的执行与恢复能力；更广泛的客户端适配、重复成功率和操作效率评价可在共同任务集上继续开展。

claim.en: ## Analytical Normalization, Circuit Constraints, and Element Integrals
claim.zh-CN: ## 解析归一化、场路与单元积分推导

claim.en: Round-wire normalization first requires 2π∫₀ᵃ r Jz(r) dr=It. The identity d[r I₁(κr)]/dr=κr I₀(κr) then gives the normalization denominator. Dividing the boundary axial electric field Jz(a)/σ by It yields the internal impedance per unit length. The independent Joule integral is compared with |It|² Re(zint) under the RMS convention. High-precision quadrature error checks only the stated analytical formula; finite ends, external return inductance, temperature changes, and insulation are not included in that analytical accuracy.
claim.zh-CN: 圆线解析归一化先要求 2π∫₀ᵃ r Jz(r) dr=It，再用 d[r I₁(κr)]/dr=κr I₀(κr) 得到分母。边界轴向电场 Jz(a)/σ 除以 It 给出内部单位长度阻抗。独立焦耳积分与 |It|² Re(zint) 对照采用 RMS 约定；高精度积分误差仅检验所写解析公式。有限端部、回流外部电感、热变化和绝缘结构并不包含在该解析精度中。

claim.en: Linear-triangle recovery uses the actual physical area aT. With nodal eₖ=v−uₖ, complex element current is σaTΣeₖ/3 and Joule power is σaT[Σ|eₖ|²+|Σeₖ|²]/12. The latter follows from the consistent mass matrix with diagonal coefficient two and off-diagonal coefficient one. Original coordinates are scaled by 0.001 m, so area carries the square of that scale; conversion to millimetres for display does not change integration. Material markers distinguish individual strands, return, and air, and the return uses its own v.
claim.zh-CN: 线性三角形场恢复使用实际物理面积 aT。令节点 eₖ=v−uₖ，则单元复电流为 σaTΣeₖ/3，焦耳功率为 σaT[Σ|eₖ|²+|Σeₖ|²]/12。后者来自对角系数 2、非对角系数 1 的一致质量矩阵。原坐标以 0.001 m 缩放，因此面积乘缩放平方；显示到 mm 不影响积分。材料标记区分每股、回流和空气，回流使用自身 v。

claim.en: Necessity and sufficiency of the common-terminal criterion depend on the same linear system and uniqueness of its solution. Necessity follows by substituting equal currents into the voltage equation. Sufficiency follows because a vector removed by Q can be represented as V1 and then satisfies the augmented system together with total current. Conductor contacts, additional terminal impedances, nonlinear material, or a missing induced term change that system. Reuse of the criterion in a new model therefore begins by reconstructing Z, e, and the constraints, rather than copying an earlier conclusion.
claim.zh-CN: 共端判据的必要性和充分性依赖同一个线性系统及解唯一性。必要性来自均流代入端压方程；充分性来自被 Q 消去的向量可以表示为 V1，并与总电流约束共同满足增广系统。导体接触、额外端接阻抗、非线性材料或遗漏的感应项会改变系统。因此在新模型里复用判据时，先重建 Z、e 与约束，而不是只复用结果。

claim.en: ## Derivation of the uniform complex-current condition
claim.zh-CN: ## 复电流均流条件的推导

claim.en: If a uniform-current solution exists, substituting i=(It/N)1 into the port equation makes all components of (It/N)Z1+e equal, establishing necessity of the projection condition. Conversely, when the projection condition holds, this vector equals a scalar V times 1. The uniform-current vector then satisfies both the port equation and the total-current constraint; uniqueness of the augmented solution makes it the actual solution, establishing sufficiency. Numerical results use sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| for normalized RMS complex-current deviation and show individual magnitudes and phases.
claim.zh-CN: 若等流解存在，将 i=(It/N)1 代入端口方程，即得向量 (It/N)Z1+e 的全部分量相同，投影条件因而必要。反之，若投影条件成立，该向量可写为某一标量 V 与 1 的乘积，等流向量同时满足端口方程和总电流约束；在增广系统解唯一时，它即为实际解，条件因而充分。数值结果以 sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| 表示归一化复电流 RMS 偏差，并同时展示逐股幅值与相位。

claim.en: The modified Bessel functions used for the round-wire reference follow the definitions in [@BESSEL]. Partial-inductance construction follows the PEEC framework [@RUEHLI1974]; the face-flux approximation is related to the Raviart–Thomas family [@RT1977]. GMRES supplies the iterative linear-solver framework [@GMRES1986], while the finite-element implementation and boundary treatment are documented in [@FEMDOC].
claim.zh-CN: 圆线基准使用的修正 Bessel 函数遵循文献 [@BESSEL] 的定义。部分电感构造采用 PEEC 框架 [@RUEHLI1974]，面通量近似与 Raviart–Thomas 单元族相关 [@RT1977]。迭代线性求解采用 GMRES 方法 [@GMRES1986]；有限元实现及边界处理参见 [@FEMDOC]。

claim.en: ## Current and power integration on linear triangles
claim.zh-CN: ## 线性三角形的电流与功率积分

claim.en: Complex current density in a linear triangle is interpolated as J=ΣₐNaJa. The area integral of each shape function is AT/3, giving the element's complex current directly. Joule loss uses the consistent mass matrix in {{eqref:E09}}. Material tags associate each element with a strand, return, or air, and areas are calculated after converting coordinates to metres. Material-wise current and loss sums are independently checked against the original field–circuit scalars.
claim.zh-CN: 线性三角形内以 J=ΣₐNaJa 插值复电流密度。每个形函数的面积积分为 AT/3，因而可直接得到单元复电流；焦耳损耗使用 {{eqref:E09}} 的一致质量矩阵计算。材料标记确定单元所属股线、回流或空气，坐标转换为米后求面积。按材料求和所得电流和损耗与原始场路标量独立核对。

claim.en: ## RT0 Face Flux and Lightweight Field Recovery
claim.zh-CN: ## RT0 面通量与轻量场恢复

claim.en: Original RT0 face fluxes are stored by direction and integer grid identity. For each cell axis, opposing fluxes q− and q+ give the center component (q−+q+)/(2h²) and local resistive power [|q−|²+|q+|²+Re(q−*q+)]/(3σh). Summing all three axes and all cells recovers total loss. Faces omitted at insulating sides have structural zero flux in the original discretization; this zero is not an independently solved boundary-flux validation.
claim.zh-CN: 原 RT0 面通量按方向及整数网格身份保存。单元每轴取相对两面的 q−、q+，中心分量为 (q−+q+)/(2h²)，轴向局部电阻功率为 [|q−|²+|q+|²+Re(q−*q+)]/(3σh)。三轴相加、全单元求和恢复总损耗。被绝缘侧边省略的面在原离散定义中具有结构零通量；这种零值不等于另做了独立边界通量场解。

claim.en: Publication postprocessing independently reconstructs complex center J for all 27648 cells and compares it with the original cell_fields.csv, while exact overlap integration checks archived loss. A section uses the actual discrete layer near the center and states its z coordinate rather than assuming that all samples lie exactly at 1 mm. The W/cm³ scale is obtained by multiplying SI loss density by 10⁻⁶. Vector sample identities and their common length scale are inspectable in the figure request and mapping data without an additional solver.
claim.zh-CN: 成稿后处理独立恢复全部 27648 单元中心复 J，与原 cell_fields.csv 对照；同时用完整重叠积分核验原损耗。切面取实际最接近中心的离散层并标注 z，不假设所有采样正好位于 1 mm。W/cm³ 色标由 SI 损耗密度乘 10⁻⁶ 得到。三维箭头的抽样身份与公共长度缩放可在图件请求和映射数据中检查，不用额外求解器。

claim.en: {{equation:E09}}
claim.zh-CN: {{equation:E09}}

claim.en: ## Agent workflows and software connections

claim.en: Codex invokes pinned AgentTools and PyAEDT-MCP through a standard MCP client bridge. Workflows define tasks and acceptance, adapters manage software connections, and model source defines deterministic computation. Formal tasks bind parameters, source hashes, and run identifiers. Status queries follow long tasks, and cancellation targets the owned process tree. Recovery uses verified inputs and checkpoints; tutorial restarts establish a linked new run identity.

claim.en: ## High-frequency loss and current sharing
claim.zh-CN: ## 高频损耗与电流分配

claim.en: Litz wire controls high-frequency current through strand insulation and longitudinal transposition. Strand diameter sets the local skin-effect scale, neighboring conductors and the return shape proximity fields, and common terminals couple the complex strand currents. A structural comparison therefore requires both an electromagnetic model and consistent definitions of copper area, axial length, and terminal conditions.
claim.zh-CN: Litz 线通过细股绝缘与沿程换位调节高频电流分布，其损耗同时受单股趋肤、股间磁耦合和端部连接影响。单股直径描述局部电流渗透的尺度，沿程位置决定各股所经历的磁场，共同端接则约束复电流的整体分配。因此，评价一种结构需要把几何参数、场路条件与可比较的损耗量联系起来，并估计相关数值不确定性。

claim.en: Discrete-transposition modeling with two-dimensional FEM (DTM) [@P01] connects strand-position permutations to cross-sectional fields. Its extension to nonideal compound transposition (iDTM) [@N01] treats hierarchical and subbundle effects. Improved segmented equivalent circuits [@P02], FEM–PEEC coupling [@P03], and quasi-two-dimensional multiconductor formulations [@P04] use different reductions of field and circuit behavior. Continuum models [@P05] and complex-permeability homogenization [@P09] reduce the cost of winding calculations. Their results must be interpreted through the fields, current constraints, and boundary conditions retained by each method.
claim.zh-CN: 现有研究从不同尺度处理这一问题。离散换位模型 DTM [@P01] 将截面二维有限元与股线位置置换结合，改进模型 iDTM [@N01] 进一步描述复合 Litz 的非理想换位；分段等效电路 iSEC [@P02] 则在指定绕组和分层假设下求解损耗。FEM–PEEC 耦合 [@P03] 与准二维多导体模型 [@P04] 提供了场量和电路量共同求解的途径。连续体模型 [@P05] 及复磁导率均匀化 [@P09] 以平均量降低绕组计算成本。这些方法在空间分辨率、换位表示和端接处理上各有侧重，结果的比较因而首先取决于模型是否描述同一物理对象与激励。

claim.en: This work connects three levels through reviewable numerical verification: round-wire analysis, multistrand two-dimensional common-terminal coupling, and finite-length longitudinal PEEC. The analytical solution supplies an internal-impedance reference; the two-dimensional model solves both intrastand fields and complex strand currents; the longitudinal model examines the influence of the finite-length kernel and integration settings on resistance. Traditional multilevel Litz provides the baseline for subsequent structural comparisons, while cross-layer paths are candidate geometries to be evaluated. The numerical conclusions apply to the degrees of freedom and boundary conditions retained at each level.
claim.zh-CN: 本文以可复核的数值验证为目标，连接单圆线解析、多股二维共端场路和有限长度纵向 PEEC 三个层次。解析解提供内部阻抗基准；二维模型同时求解股内场与股间复电流；纵向模型用于考察有限长度核及积分设置对电阻的影响。传统多级 Litz 是后续结构比较的基线，跨层路径属于待评价的候选几何。本文给出的数值结论限于各层实际包含的自由度和边界条件。

claim.en: ## Research questions and contributions
claim.zh-CN: ## 研究问题与本文工作

claim.en: This paper addresses three related questions: whether independent discretizations reproduce round-wire skin current and loss; how uniform complex strand currents can be characterized under common terminal voltage; and how finite-length longitudinal PEEC resistance responds to length, integration, and cross-sectional discretization. We organize verification by observable, derive a current-sharing condition for a specified linear field–circuit model, and report quantitative results for a 640-strand two-dimensional case and longitudinal cases with 1264 and 5024 degrees of freedom. Supplementary three-dimensional imposed-field, potential-diagnostic, and interface cases identify the implementation's applicability and the conditions required for further research.
claim.zh-CN: 本文回答三个相互关联的问题：独立离散方法能否复现单圆线的趋肤电流和损耗；共同端电压下，怎样判断各股复电流是否均匀；有限长度纵向 PEEC 的电阻对长度、积分和横向离散有多大敏感性。相应地，本文建立按观测量组织的验证关系，推导指定线性场路模型的均流条件，并给出 640 股二维算例及 1264、5024 自由度纵向算例的定量结果。三维外场算例、场势诊断和接口验证作为补充材料，用于说明现有实现的适用范围与进一步研究所需的条件。

claim.en: ## Operating conditions and comparison quantities
claim.zh-CN: ## 工况与比较量

claim.en: Calculations use SI units, the exp(jωt) time convention, and RMS phasors. Copper at 20 °C has conductivity σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m and relative permeability μr=1. The principal transport condition is 200 kHz and 20 A RMS, with zero independent imposed field. Strands are insulated along their lengths and connected in parallel at their ends. Resistance and loss are normalized by axial length; actual strand arc lengths enter copper volume and DC resistance separately. Finite-segment terminal voltage is measured in V, while the two-dimensional axial terminal field is measured in V/m, with the chosen axial length connecting the two.
claim.zh-CN: 计算采用 SI 单位、exp(jωt) 时间约定和 RMS 相量。材料为 20 ℃ 铜，电导率 σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m，相对磁导率 μr=1；主输运工况为 200 kHz、20 A RMS，独立外加场为零。股线沿途绝缘、端部并联。电阻和损耗按轴向长度归一化，股线的实际弧长另行计入铜体积与直流电阻。有限段端电压的单位为 V，二维轴向端场的单位为 V/m，二者通过所采用的轴向长度建立联系。

claim.en: The original Q1 round wire, 2 mm in diameter, provides an analytical calibration. Its copper area is 3.141593 mm² and its mean DC current density at 20 A is 6.366198 A/mm², exceeding the specified limit of 4 A/mm². Q2 therefore requires at least 5 mm² copper cross-section. For 640 strands of copper diameter 0.100 mm, the ideal circular area is 5.026548 mm². Each strand in the two-dimensional model is represented by a 64-sided polygon, giving an actual copper area of {{metric:coax_area}} mm². Equal-copper comparisons use this discrete area so that the electromagnetic reference incorporates the same geometric approximation.
claim.zh-CN: 原题 Q1 的直径 2 mm 圆线用于解析校准。其铜面积为 3.141593 mm²，在 20 A 下的平均直流电流密度为 6.366198 A/mm²，超过题设 4 A/mm² 限值。满足该限值的 Q2 需至少 5 mm² 铜截面。640 股、单股铜径 0.100 mm 的理想圆面积为 5.026548 mm²，二维模型以 64 边形表示每股，实际铜面积为 {{metric:coax_area}} mm²。等铜比较使用实际离散面积，使几何近似的影响与电磁结果具有一致的参照。

claim.en: For unequal strand arc lengths, parallel conductances determine DC resistance and the sum of strand area–length products determines copper volume, as in {{eqref:E01}}. We examine absolute AC resistance, Rac/Rdc, copper loss, and complex current sharing. Equation {{eqref:E02}} gives RMS Joule loss and defines resistance from copper dissipation under pure transport excitation. The supplementary RT0 case uses an independent imposed field and zero net transport, so its absorbed power is reported separately as imposed-field loss.
claim.zh-CN: 各股具有不同弧长时，直流电阻由并联电导求得，铜体积由各股面积与弧长乘积相加，见 {{eqref:E01}}。本文同时考察绝对交流电阻、Rac/Rdc、铜损耗与复电流分配。RMS 相量下的焦耳损耗见 {{eqref:E02}}；该式中电阻由纯输运工况的铜损耗定义。补充材料的 RT0 算例采用独立外场和零净输运，其吸收功率以外场损耗单独报告。

claim.en: ## Model hierarchy and verification relationships
claim.zh-CN: ## 模型层级与验证关系

claim.en: The models are related as shown in {{figref:model_hierarchy}}. Analytical round-wire and two-dimensional diffusion models share the long, straight internal-field problem, allowing radial current and internal resistance to be compared. The two-dimensional common-terminal model additionally retains intrastand distributions, interstrand currents, and a controlled return, supporting field–circuit analysis of a specified cross-section. Longitudinal PEEC uses a finite-length partial-inductance kernel to examine the effect of length on axial currents. The three-component RT0 model uses imposed-field absorption in a cuboid to test three-dimensional continuity and discrete operators. Transposition paths and actual end regions require corresponding longitudinal or transverse degrees of freedom in subsequent structural research.
claim.zh-CN: 各模型的关系如 {{figref:model_hierarchy}} 所示。解析圆线与二维扩散模型具有共同的长直内场问题，可比较径向电流和内部电阻。二维共端模型进一步保留股内分布、股间电流与受控回流，适合研究指定截面的场路耦合。纵向 PEEC 采用有限长度部分电感核，可检查长度对轴向电流解的影响。三分量 RT0 模型则以长方体外场吸收为算例，检验三维电流连续性与离散算子。换位路径和实际端区需要相应的沿程或横向自由度，属于后续三维结构研究的范围。

claim.en: Verification comprises equation solution, physical constraints, power consistency, and parameter sensitivity. Targets are 10⁻⁸ for true linear residuals, common-terminal conditions, and total complex current; 0.1% for independent power balance; and 1% for changes in mesh, segmentation, boundary, and length. Analytical reference values and current/power integrals use thresholds of 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻⁸, respectively. The RT0 GMRES true-residual target is 10⁻¹¹, its quadrature-sensitivity target is 0.1%, and same-model CPU/GPU matrix and complex-current comparisons use 10⁻¹⁰.
claim.zh-CN: 验证分为方程求解、物理约束、功率一致性和参数敏感性四部分。真实线性残差、共同端条件与总复电流误差的目标为 10⁻⁸，独立功率平衡为 0.1%，网格、分段、边界及长度变化的比较目标为 1%。解析参考与电流、功率积分分别使用 10⁻⁶ 和 10⁻⁸ 门槛。RT0 的 GMRES 真残差目标为 10⁻¹¹，积分敏感性为 0.1%；同模型 CPU/GPU 矩阵与复电流的对照门槛为 10⁻¹⁰。

claim.en: These checks answer different questions. Residuals measure the accuracy of the discrete-system solution, power balance tests field–circuit and postprocessing consistency, and parameter sensitivity describes changes over specified perturbations. Model omissions, boundary approximations, and experimental deviations require their own evidence. We therefore distinguish numerical checks from physical applicability and interpret finite sensitivity studies as local validation rather than a common upper bound on total model error.
claim.zh-CN: 这些检查回答不同的问题。残差衡量离散系统的求解精度，功率平衡检查场路与后处理的一致性，参数敏感性表征指定扰动范围内的变化。模型遗漏、边界近似及实验偏差需要相应的独立证据。因此，下文分别说明数值检查结果及其物理适用范围，并把有限敏感性结果作为局部验证，而非全模型误差的统一上界。

claim.en: ## Common-terminal coupling and uniform complex currents
claim.zh-CN: ## 共端场路与复电流均流条件

claim.en: The common endpoints, strand branches, and return are related in {{figref:common_terminal}}. Let Z be the coupled impedance matrix of a specified linear model, e the independently induced voltage, i the complex strand currents, and V the common terminal voltage. The port equation Zi+e=V1 and total-current constraint 1ᵀi=It form {{eqref:E04}}. Solving the augmented system yields both magnitude and phase; It/N serves as a reference for the resulting current distribution.
claim.zh-CN: 共同端点、股线支路与回流的关系见 {{figref:common_terminal}}。令 Z 为指定线性模型的耦合阻抗矩阵，e 为独立外场引起的感应项，i 为各股复电流，V 为公共端电压。端口方程 Z i+e=V1 与总电流条件 1ᵀi=It 共同构成 {{eqref:E04}}。求解该增广系统可同时得到幅值和相位，等流值 It/N 用于比较求得的电流分布。

claim.en: When the augmented system has a unique solution, substitution of i=(It/N)1 shows that uniform currents exist if and only if every component of (It/N)Z1+e is equal. Projecting this vector onto the subspace orthogonal to 1 gives {{eqref:E05}}. Without an independent imposed field, the condition reduces to equal row sums of Z; with an imposed field, the induced term also determines current sharing. This necessary and sufficient condition applies to the selected impedance model and terminal conditions, expressing the effect of transposition through changes in coupling and induced voltages.
claim.zh-CN: 在增广系统具有唯一解时，令 i=(It/N)1 可知：等流解存在，当且仅当向量 (It/N)Z1+e 的所有分量相同。将该向量投影到与 1 正交的子空间，便得到 {{eqref:E05}}。无独立外场时，条件简化为 Z 的各行和相同；存在外场时，感应项也参与决定均流。该判据给出了所选阻抗模型与端接条件下的充要条件，便于将几何换位的作用具体落实到耦合矩阵及感应项的变化上。

claim.en: The two-dimensional common-terminal FEM solves the shared axial terminal field jointly with Az degrees of freedom. In conductors, Jz=σ(v−u), where both v and the saved variable u are expressed in V/m; the return conductor uses its corresponding terminal field. Current and loss are integrated on material-tagged linear triangles after coordinates are converted from mm to m. Strand currents, bundle loss, return loss, and copper area are independently compared with the original field–circuit results, treating air and conductor regions separately.
claim.zh-CN: 二维共端 FEM 将公共轴向端场与 Az 自由度联合求解。导体内按 Jz=σ(v−u) 恢复电流密度，其中 v 与保存变量 u 均以 V/m 表示，回流导体使用相应的端场。电流和损耗由带材料标记的线性三角形积分，坐标由 mm 转换为 m 后计算面积。由此得到的逐股复电流、束内损耗、回流损耗及铜面积，与原始场路结果独立核对；空气区域与各导体区域分别处理。

claim.en: ## Finite-length longitudinal PEEC
claim.zh-CN: ## 有限长度纵向 PEEC

claim.en: Longitudinal PEEC divides the cross-section into volume filaments, each carrying an axial complex current density uniform along its length. Ohmic resistance and finite-volume partial inductance follow {{eqref:E08}}, forming Z=R+jωL before the common-port and total-current constraints in {{eqref:E04}} are applied. The counts 1264 and 5024 denote volume-filament degrees of freedom in a continuous conductor. Differences between their currents represent internal current concentration within the longitudinal basis.
claim.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 将导体截面离散为体积细丝，每条细丝内采用沿轴向、沿长度均匀的复电流密度。欧姆电阻与有限体积对的部分电感由 {{eqref:E08}} 给出，并形成 Z=R+jωL，随后按 {{eqref:E04}} 施加公共端口和总电流约束。1264 与 5024 表示体积细丝自由度；这些细丝是连续导体的离散单元。同一截面内各体积细丝的电流差异表示内部电流集中，所用基函数的范围为纵向电流。

claim.en: {{equation:E08}}
claim.zh-CN: {{equation:E08}}

claim.en: The longitudinal case has a nominal round-wire diameter of 2 mm. The m40 and m80 square filaments are 0.050 and 0.025 mm wide, giving actual cross-sectional areas of 3.16 and 3.14 mm². Sensitivity studies vary length, mutual integration, or self integration independently. The 1264-degree-of-freedom model uses one cross-section at lengths 0.16, 0.32, and 0.64 m. At fixed length, mutual quadrature order q is increased through 4, 6, and 8, while self-integration settings increase from 10/8 to 12/10. These pairs are AccuracyGoal and PrecisionGoal, the target absolute and relative precision digits. The 5024-degree-of-freedom model checks lengths 0.32 and 0.64 m and the same integration changes. Because the two cross-sectional discretizations have slightly different copper areas, each resistance is compared with its own equal-area Bessel reference; changes between discretizations include both discretization and area approximation.
claim.zh-CN: 纵向算例的名义圆线直径为 2 mm。m40 与 m80 的方形细丝宽度分别为 0.050 mm 和 0.025 mm，对应实际截面面积 3.16 mm² 和 3.14 mm²。敏感性试验分别改变长度、互项积分或自项积分设置。1264 自由度模型采用同一截面与 0.16、0.32、0.64 m 三档长度；固定长度后，将互项积分阶数 q 依次取为 4、6、8，自项精度从 10/8 提高至 12/10；两个数字依次表示自项数值积分的 AccuracyGoal 与 PrecisionGoal，即绝对精度和相对精度的目标位数。5024 自由度模型复核 0.32、0.64 m 长度及相同积分变化。两种截面离散的铜面积略有差异，因此各档电阻分别与自身等面积圆线的 Bessel 解比较；跨档变化同时包含离散和面积近似的影响。

claim.en: ## Interpretation of current sharing and loss
claim.zh-CN: ## 对电流分配与损耗的解释

claim.en: The three result levels answer the questions posed in the introduction. Round-wire analysis and two-dimensional calibration establish a local skin-effect reference. The 640-strand results show that common terminal voltage permits substantially different complex strand currents, so strand size and interstrand uniformity require separate assessment. Longitudinal PEEC quantifies length and integration effects for its chosen basis. Structural comparisons consequently require control of actual copper area, return, terminals, and axial length, together with transposition-induced changes in coupling. Small discretization changes help identify numerically stable intervals; structural advantages must still be compared with relevant model errors and experimental uncertainty.
claim.zh-CN: 三个层次的结果分别回答了引言提出的问题。单圆线解析与二维校准建立局部趋肤基准；640 股结果显示，共同端电压允许各股具有显著不同的复电流，单股尺寸与股间均流应分别评价；纵向 PEEC 则量化了给定基函数下长度和积分的影响。由此，结构比较需要同时控制实际铜面积、回流、端接与轴向长度，并将换位所改变的耦合关系纳入场路求解。较小的离散变化有助于识别数值稳定区间，结构优势仍须与相关模型误差及实验不确定性共同比较。

claim.en: DTM and iDTM [@P01; @N01] provide a foundation for connecting longitudinal positions with cross-sectional fields. The common-terminal criterion expresses uniform-current requirements as an algebraic condition on the coupled matrix and induced terms, helping test whether a transposition approximation retains important differences. The segmented circuits of iSEC [@P02] and current constraints of quasi-two-dimensional methods [@P04] also show the need for joint field–circuit solution. Continuum and complex-permeability methods [@P05; @P09] lower macroscopic computational cost; strand currents and local losses require recovery consistent with their averaging assumptions. These works inform the methods, while our quantitative verification uses its own operating conditions, discretizations, and error records. Comparing experimental accuracy across methods requires a common case.
claim.zh-CN: DTM 与 iDTM [@P01; @N01] 为连接沿程位置和截面场提供了方法基础；本文的共端判据进一步把均流要求表述为耦合矩阵与感应项的代数条件，可用于检查给定换位近似是否保留关键差异。iSEC [@P02] 的分段电路和准二维方法 [@P04] 的电流约束，也体现了场路协同求解的必要性。连续体与复磁导率方法 [@P05; @P09] 适合降低宏观计算成本，逐股电流及局部损耗则需要与其平均化假设一致的恢复方法。上述文献提供方法参照；本文的定量验证采用自身工况、离散和误差记录，各方法的实验精度需在共同算例下比较。

claim.en: The main current uncertainty arises from differences between actual structures and simplified models. A straight two-dimensional bundle omits longitudinal transposition, and longitudinal PEEC omits transverse loops and actual end-current redistribution. The RT0 imposed-field case tests absorption in a fixed cuboid. Supplementary three-dimensional A–φ cylinder calibration retains failures in φ and gauge residuals, while the native three-dimensional Ansys interface has not produced an acceptable field solution. Temperature rise, insulation thickness, winding tolerances, and terminal contacts require thermal modeling and experimental assessment. These factors limit transfer of the present results to actual Litz performance.
claim.zh-CN: 现阶段的主要不确定性来自实际结构与简化模型之间的差异。二维直束省略沿程换位，纵向 PEEC 的基函数省略横向环流和真实端部重分布；RT0 外场算例检验的是固定长方体中的外场吸收。补充材料记录的三维 A–φ 圆柱校准仍有 φ 与规范残差未通过，Ansys 原生三维接口也尚未形成可接受场解。此外，温升、绝缘厚度、绕制公差与端接接触尚待热模型和实验评价。这些因素限定了当前结果向实际 Litz 性能的推广范围。

claim.en: ## Priorities for subsequent verification
claim.zh-CN: ## 后续验证的重点

claim.en: Subsequent work should first establish consistent boundaries, gauge treatment, terminal fields, and independent power integrals on manageable three-dimensional cylinders and small-strand structures. Actual terminals and transverse degrees of freedom can then be introduced before comparing traditional multilevel and cross-layer structures meeting the copper-area requirement. Experiments can measure complex impedance at matched frequency, temperature, return, and axial length while recording terminal resistance and geometric tolerances. This sequence separates numerical implementation errors, geometric approximations, and manufacturing deviations and supplies a comparable basis for structural ranking.
claim.zh-CN: 后续工作宜先在规模可控的三维圆柱和小股数结构上，使边界、规范、端场与独立功率积分形成一致验证；随后引入真实端接和横向自由度，再比较满足铜面积要求的传统多级与跨层结构。实验可在相同频率、温度、回流与轴向长度下测量复阻抗，同时记录端接电阻和几何公差。这样的顺序能将数值实现误差、几何近似及实际制造偏差逐步区分，并为结构性能排名提供可比较的依据。

claim.en: Under common phasor, length, and area definitions, this paper establishes verification relationships among round-wire analysis, two-dimensional common-terminal coupling, and finite-length longitudinal PEEC. The finest two-dimensional internal-field mesh has a relative analytical resistance error of 1.79×10⁻⁶. For parallel-connected strands, uniform currents are characterized by a zero differential-subspace projection of coupled impedance and imposed-field induction. Complex currents in the 640-strand straight bundle show that common terminals and fine subdivision must be assessed together with magnetic coupling. Longitudinal PEEC meets the relevant sensitivity targets for the tested lengths and integration settings; the final 5024-degree-of-freedom resistance differs by 0.044582% from its equal-area Bessel reference.
claim.zh-CN: 本文在统一相量、长度和面积定义下，建立了单圆线解析、二维共端场路与有限长度纵向 PEEC 的验证关系。二维内场解的最细网格电阻解析误差为 1.79×10⁻⁶。对端部并联的股线，等流条件可表述为耦合阻抗与外场感应项在差模子空间中的投影为零；640 股直束的复电流结果表明，共同端接与细股划分仍需结合磁耦合评价均流。纵向 PEEC 在已检查长度和积分设置下达到相应敏感性目标，5024 自由度末档电阻与本档等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。

claim.en: These results provide local-field references, common-terminal constraints, and finite-length computational benchmarks for research on actual transposition. RT0 imposed-field cases, CPU/GPU comparisons, and three-dimensional diagnostics further describe the implementations' ranges. Ranking actual Litz structures requires three-dimensional verification with end regions and transverse degrees of freedom, followed by thermal assessment and controlled experiments.
claim.zh-CN: 这些结果为后续真实换位结构研究提供了局部场基准、共端约束和有限长度计算的参照。RT0 外场、CPU/GPU 对照及三维诊断资料补充说明了各实现的范围。实际 Litz 结构的性能排序仍需具有端区和横向自由度的三维验证，并结合温升与受控实验完成评价。

claim.en: ## Round-wire radial equation and normalization
claim.zh-CN: ## 圆线径向方程与归一化

claim.en: Axial current inside a long straight round wire satisfies (1/r)d(r dJz/dr)/dr=κ²Jz. Finiteness at the axis selects I₀(κr), and the total complex-current constraint together with ∫₀ᵃrI₀(κr)dr=aI₁(κa)/κ fixes its coefficient. Surface axial electric field divided by total current gives internal impedance per unit length. An independent Joule integral of current density checks the relationship between its real part and loss. The derivation uses the same RMS phasors as the main text.
claim.zh-CN: 长直圆线内部的轴向电流满足 (1/r)d(r dJz/dr)/dr=κ²Jz。轴心有限性确定径向函数为 I₀(κr)，总复电流约束与积分关系 ∫₀ᵃrI₀(κr)dr=aI₁(κa)/κ 确定其系数。表面轴向电场与总电流之比给出单位长度内部阻抗；对电流密度独立执行焦耳积分，可核对阻抗实部与损耗之间的关系。推导采用与正文一致的 RMS 相量。

claim.en: ## Derivation of the uniform complex-current condition
claim.zh-CN: ## 复电流均流条件的推导

claim.en: If a uniform-current solution exists, substituting i=(It/N)1 into the port equation makes all components of (It/N)Z1+e equal, establishing necessity of the projection condition. Conversely, when the projection condition holds, this vector equals a scalar V times 1. The uniform-current vector then satisfies both the port equation and the total-current constraint; uniqueness of the augmented solution makes it the actual solution, establishing sufficiency. Numerical results use sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| for normalized RMS complex-current deviation and show individual magnitudes and phases.
claim.zh-CN: 若等流解存在，将 i=(It/N)1 代入端口方程，即得向量 (It/N)Z1+e 的全部分量相同，投影条件因而必要。反之，若投影条件成立，该向量可写为某一标量 V 与 1 的乘积，等流向量同时满足端口方程和总电流约束；在增广系统解唯一时，它即为实际解，条件因而充分。数值结果以 sqrt(mean(|ik−It/N|²))/|It/N| 表示归一化复电流 RMS 偏差，并同时展示逐股幅值与相位。

claim.en: ## Mapping strand identity to cross-sectional position
claim.zh-CN: ## 股线身份与截面位置的变换

claim.en: Let Ps map fixed physical strand identities to spatial positions in cross-section s. Local currents are Ps i, and local voltages transformed back to identity coordinates are PsᵀZsPs i. Summing in series with segment lengths Δzs gives {{eqref:E06}}. Position and identity are retained separately; K, 2K, and 4K segmentation comparisons use the same trajectory and strands. Periodicity, clearance, and curvature check the paths, while actual arc lengths and copper volume quantify material use.
claim.zh-CN: 令 Ps 将固定物理股线身份映射到第 s 个截面的空间位置，则局部电流为 Ps i，转换回身份坐标的局部电压为 PsᵀZsPs i。按段长 Δzs 串联相加得到 {{eqref:E06}}。在这一表示中，位置与身份分别保存，K、2K、4K 的分段比较使用同一轨迹和同一组股线。周期、间隙与曲率用于检查轨迹，实际弧长和铜体积用于比较材料用量。

claim.en: {{equation:E06}}
claim.zh-CN: {{equation:E06}}

claim.en: ## Longitudinal filament basis and kernel integration
claim.zh-CN: ## 纵向细丝基函数与核积分

claim.en: Within volume filament α, current density is constant at iα/Aα and directed axially. Volume integration of vector potential gives the induced electric field in a testing filament; integration along its length yields a symmetric partial-inductance matrix. Coincident points produce an integrable self-term singularity treated with dedicated precision settings, while mutual terms use a separate quadrature order. Ohmic resistance and jωL form the coupled matrix, solved jointly with common terminal voltage and total current. The basis determines the current directions represented by this model.
claim.zh-CN: 第 α 条体积细丝中的电流密度取为常量 iα/Aα，方向沿轴向。由矢势体积积分得到测试细丝内的感应电场，再沿长度积分，可得对称部分电感矩阵。自项在重合点具有可积奇性，使用专门的自项精度控制；互项采用独立积分阶数。欧姆电阻与 jωL 组成耦合矩阵，并与公共端电压和总电流约束联合求解。所用基函数决定了这一模型能够表示的电流方向。

claim.en: ## Current and power integration on linear triangles
claim.zh-CN: ## 线性三角形的电流与功率积分

claim.en: Complex current density in a linear triangle is interpolated as J=ΣₐNaJa. The area integral of each shape function is AT/3, giving the element's complex current directly. Joule loss uses the consistent mass matrix in {{eqref:E09}}. Material tags associate each element with a strand, return, or air, and areas are calculated after converting coordinates to metres. Material-wise current and loss sums are independently checked against the original field–circuit scalars.
claim.zh-CN: 线性三角形内以 J=ΣₐNaJa 插值复电流密度。每个形函数的面积积分为 AT/3，因而可直接得到单元复电流；焦耳损耗使用 {{eqref:E09}} 的一致质量矩阵计算。材料标记确定单元所属股线、回流或空气，坐标转换为米后求面积。按材料求和所得电流和损耗与原始场路标量独立核对。

claim.en: {{equation:E09}}
claim.zh-CN: {{equation:E09}}

claim.en: The round-wire derivation uses the definitions and integral relations of modified Bessel functions. Longitudinal coupling uses the resistance and partial-inductance description of partial-element equivalent circuits. [@BESSEL; @RUEHLI1974]
claim.zh-CN: 圆线推导采用修正 Bessel 函数的定义与积分关系；纵向耦合采用部分元件等效电路的电阻和部分电感表述。[@BESSEL; @RUEHLI1974]

claim.en: ## Geometry sampling and discrete transposition
claim.zh-CN: ## 几何采样与离散换位

claim.en: {{figref:geometry_comparison}} shows straight, single-level, traditional multilevel and cross-layer centerlines. The geometry records preserve strand identity, periodicity, clearance, curvature, actual arc length and copper volume. Axial sampling at 400, 800 and 1600 points and 60 checks support sampling consistency for these quantities. The illustrated 24-strand structure with a copper diameter of 0.100 mm has a nominal copper area of approximately 0.1885 mm² and demonstrates geometry construction. A structure meeting the minimum 5 mm² copper area requires separate construction and verification. Three-dimensional views reveal spatial paths; the corresponding field-circuit model evaluates electromagnetic performance.
claim.zh-CN: {{figref:geometry_comparison}} 展示直束、单级、传统多级与跨层中心线。几何记录包括股线身份、周期、间隙、曲率、实际弧长和铜体积，400、800、1600 轴向采样及 60 项检查支持这些量的采样一致性。所示 24 股、0.100 mm 铜径结构的名义铜面积约为 0.1885 mm²，用于说明几何构造；满足至少 5 mm² 铜面积的结构需另行建立并验证。三维视角用于观察空间路径，电磁性能由相应场路模型评价。

claim.en: The current DTM/iDTM demonstration uses the additive discrete blocks in {{eqref:E06}}. For the same weighted impedance blocks, their sum is invariant to ordering; this implementation therefore checks identity mappings and circuit accumulation of the specified blocks. Comparing actual transposition paths additionally requires longitudinal position changes, noncommuting relationships between levels, local fields, and terminal conditions. These assumptions determine comparability with the literature [@P01; @N01].
claim.zh-CN: 当前 DTM/iDTM 演示采用 {{eqref:E06}} 的加性离散块。对于同一组带权阻抗块，求和结果对排列顺序保持不变，因此该实现可验证身份映射和给定块的电路叠加。真实换位路径的比较还需考虑位置随长度的变化、层级间的非交换关系、局部场及端接条件。与文献 [@P01; @N01] 对照时，这些具体假设决定两种实现具有多大可比性。

claim.en: ## RT0 cuboid under an imposed field
claim.zh-CN: ## RT0 长方体外场算例

claim.en: The case is a homogeneous copper cuboid of 1×1×2 mm at 200 kHz, with imposed Bz=1 mT RMS and zero net transport. Three-component current is represented by face-flux degrees of freedom, with separate continuity, port-constraint, and imposed-field power checks. At quadrature q=14, meshes of 8192, 16000, and 27648 cells give losses of 0.927463, 0.933539, and 0.936927 mW. Consecutive refinement changes are 0.655090% and 0.362916%, below the 1% target. Increasing the finest case to q=18 changes loss and complex face flux relatively by 1.55×10⁻⁸ and 1.39×10⁻⁸, respectively, below the 0.1% quadrature target; see {{figref:rt0_spatial}}.
claim.zh-CN: 算例为 1×1×2 mm 均质铜长方体，频率 200 kHz，外加 Bz=1 mT RMS，净输运电流为零。三分量电流以面通量自由度表示，分别检查连续性、端口约束和外场功率。采用 q=14 积分时，8192、16000、27648 单元的损耗为 0.927463、0.933539、0.936927 mW；连续两次细化变化为 0.655090% 和 0.362916%，低于 1% 目标。末档提高至 q=18 后，损耗与复面通量的相对变化分别为 1.55×10⁻⁸ 和 1.39×10⁻⁸，低于 0.1% 积分目标，见 {{figref:rt0_spatial}}。

claim.en: Sections and vectors in {{figref:rt0_sections}} and {{figref:rt0_vectors}} are reconstructed from saved face fluxes. Cell-center current is obtained by averaging opposite-face fluxes and dividing by face area. Cell-average loss density uses the full local RT0 overlap integral and therefore includes within-cell variation. Arrows show the real current at zero phase with one common length scale; color represents the complex RMS norm. Section locations and vector samples follow the figure annotations, while volume integration uses all cells.

Applicability has yet to extend to curved Litz masks, independently validated boundary fluxes, and actual transport terminals. The original q=18 summary's missing metrics and failure status, CSV-based postprocessing acceptance, and resource records for dense and matrix-free implementations are retained separately to preserve the relationship between solution and interpretation.
claim.zh-CN: 各档记录的 GMRES 迭代次数为 35，真残差满足 10⁻¹¹ 目标。空间与积分比较共同支持固定外场长方体的数值结论，适用范围尚未扩展至曲线 Litz 掩膜、独立边界通量验证和实际输运端接。q=18 原摘要中的缺失指标与失败状态、基于 CSV 的后处理验收，以及致密和矩阵自由实现的资源记录分别列入来源资料，以保持求解和数据解释的对应关系。

claim.en: The historical two-dimensional seven-strand port test uses 704 elements, two voltage basis solutions, and a third actual ±20 A field solution. claim.en: Route inventories connect original WXF files, checkpoints, Ansys projects, logs, and postprocessing outputs through model, parameter, source, and run identities. JSON/CSV retain real and imaginary components, units, and strand identities. Where a source field's unit label is ambiguous, canonical quantities follow the source model definition and document the conversion. Figure mappings further connect data, plotting expressions, independent PDF/SVG/PNG exports, and composite layouts. Inventories identify the coverage of scalar integrals, spatial fields, and partially recovered results separately.

The longitudinal PEEC 1.28 m case is unexecuted. Postprocessing acceptance has an independent identity, allowing data recovery, numerical execution, and physical validation to be distinguished.
