claim.en: A scientific result typically passes through model selection, parameter interpretation, software calls, solution, postprocessing, and written interpretation. These stages use different representations and success criteria: a working tool connection does not establish a correct model, and a normal solver exit does not establish acceptable current, power, or discretization error. When an agent participates in modeling, natural-language requests must become executable objects, and each decision must connect to evidence that can be saved and examined.
claim.zh-CN: 科学计算中的一次结果通常经历模型选择、参数解释、软件调用、求解、后处理和论述等环节。这些环节使用不同的数据表示与成功判据：工具能够连接并不说明模型设置正确，求解器正常退出也不说明电流、功率或离散误差满足研究要求。智能体参与建模时，需要把自然语言任务转化为可执行对象，并把每项判断连接到可保存、可检查的证据。

claim.en: Using Litz wire as a case study, this work combines the Codex client, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Wolfram Language, and Ansys Electronics Desktop into an automated research workflow. Codex decomposes tasks, edits source, invokes tools, and interprets results; MCP supplies tool discovery and invocation; project runners validate inputs, bind source identities, control process resources, and retain outputs. Independent calculations and explicit tolerances determine physical acceptance. This division turns interactive exploration into research objects that another investigator can execute and extend. [@CODEX; @MCP; @WOLFRAM; @AEDT]
claim.zh-CN: 本研究以 Litz 线为实例，将 Codex 客户端、模型上下文协议 MCP、Wolfram Language 与 Ansys Electronics Desktop 组合为自动化研究流程。Codex 承担任务分解、源码编辑、工具调用和结果解释；MCP 提供工具发现与调用；项目运行器负责输入校验、源码身份、进程资源和产物保存；物理验收由独立计算与明确容差完成。该分工使交互中的探索能够转化为接手者可继续执行的研究对象。[@CODEX; @MCP; @WOLFRAM; @AEDT]

claim.en: Litz modeling imposes concrete requirements on this workflow. Analytical round-wire, two-dimensional common-terminal, finite-length PEEC, imposed-field RT0, and three-dimensional A–φ models retain different degrees of freedom and excitations, so their results must be interpreted through their respective observables. Literature on transposition and multiscale modeling informs model selection; complex strand currents, actual copper area, and return conditions determine whether implementations can be compared directly. [@P01; @N01; @RUEHLI1974; @RT1977]
claim.zh-CN: Litz 建模对这一流程提出了具体要求。解析圆线、二维共端模型、有限长度 PEEC、外场 RT0 和三维 A–φ 保留的自由度与激励不同，结果需要按对应观测量解释。换位方法与多尺度建模文献提供了选择模型的基础；逐股复电流、实际铜面积和回流条件则决定不同实现能否直接比较。[@P01; @N01; @RUEHLI1974; @RT1977]

claim.en: This paper addresses three engineering questions: how to share a traceable task identity across client, tool, and solver; how to connect protocol checks with physical acceptance; and how to retain sufficient recovery information during code extension, interface errors, and numerical failure. Evaluation uses six classes of recorded rc.2 cases, and conclusions concern the capabilities exercised by those cases. Client comparisons, manual-effort baselines, and large-sample success rates require separately designed experiments.
claim.zh-CN: 本文研究三个工程问题：如何使客户端、工具和求解器共享可追溯的任务身份；如何把协议检查与物理验收组织成相互衔接的步骤；以及如何在代码扩展、接口错误和数值未通过时保留足够的恢复信息。评价材料来自 rc.2 的六类运行案例，结论对应这些案例实际覆盖的功能。客户端比较、人工操作耗时对照和大样本成功率需要另外设计实验。

claim.en: {{figure:model_hierarchy}}
claim.zh-CN: {{figure:model_hierarchy}}

claim.en: The system has three layers: research workflows, execution adapters, and physical models. Workflows define inputs, operation order, checking criteria, and completion conditions; adapters manage connections and execution for Wolfram, AEDT, and numerical backends; models retain equations, discretizations, and route tests. Parameters and artifacts pass through a common task interface, allowing the command line, Notebook, and MCP entry points to refer to the same saved inputs.
claim.zh-CN: 系统分为研究工作流、执行适配和物理模型三个层次。工作流定义任务输入、操作顺序、检查依据和完成条件；适配层管理 Wolfram、AEDT 及数值后端的连接和执行；模型层保存公式、离散实现与路线测试。参数与产物通过共同任务接口流转，使命令行、Notebook 和 MCP 入口能够引用同一份已保存输入。

claim.en: The Wolfram connection pins AgentTools 2.2.0 at commit 9c99e2da5286c2ff7ac2298956107cd9334c6e90; the existing validation records use Wolfram kernel 15.0.0. Tools expose code evaluation, testing, and Notebook reading and writing. Kernel computation and frontend persistence are checked separately: returned numerical expressions support computational checks, while the frontend opens, saves, reopens, and reads back Notebook graphics to verify the delivered document. [@AGENTTOOLS]
claim.zh-CN: Wolfram 接入固定 AgentTools 2.2.0，来源提交为 9c99e2da5286c2ff7ac2298956107cd9334c6e90；既有验证记录使用 Wolfram 内核 15.0.0。工具提供代码执行、测试以及 Notebook 读写。内核计算和前端保存分别检查：数值表达式的返回值支持计算检查，Notebook 则通过前端打开、保存、重开与图形回读检查交付内容。[@AGENTTOOLS]

claim.en: The Ansys connection pins PyAEDT-MCP 0.2.dev0 at commit 80ae7c3cb47e5de7b744a2898061510299d3bcef, with PyAEDT 1.8.0 for model construction. The server runs in a separate CPython environment. The project runner starts and records its own AEDT Student gRPC session before MCP connects to that session. AEDT's embedded scripting environment and external CPython expose different modules and object interfaces, so call records retain the actual execution location, tool name, and returned value. [@PYAEDTMCP; @PYAEDT; @ANSYSCOMMONMCP]
claim.zh-CN: Ansys 接入固定 PyAEDT-MCP 0.2.dev0，来源提交为 80ae7c3cb47e5de7b744a2898061510299d3bcef；建模适配采用 PyAEDT 1.8.0。服务器在独立 CPython 环境中运行，项目运行器启动并记录所属 AEDT Student gRPC 会话，再由 MCP 连接到该会话。AEDT 内置脚本环境与外部 CPython 具有不同的模块和对象接口，调用记录因此保留实际执行位置、工具名与返回值。[@PYAEDTMCP; @PYAEDT; @ANSYSCOMMONMCP]

claim.en: The default configuration uses local standard input/output transport; the configuration generator also supports local HTTP. Installation materials pin upstream sources, dependencies, and licenses, while connection diagnostics inspect actual paths and available tools. Wolfram, AEDT, and fonts form part of the runtime environment, with versions and license conditions recorded per run. Other MCP clients can use the same task descriptions and protocol interface; the end-to-end records in this paper concern Codex with a standard MCP client bridge.
claim.zh-CN: 默认配置采用本地标准输入输出传输，配置生成器也提供本机 HTTP 方式。安装材料固定上游来源、依赖和许可，连接诊断核对实际路径与工具清单。Wolfram、AEDT 及字体是运行环境的组成部分，版本和许可证条件随运行记录保存。其他 MCP 客户端可使用相同任务说明和协议接口，本文端到端记录对应 Codex 与标准 MCP 客户端桥接。

claim.en: Research source and software connections have distinct responsibilities, allowing models to run independently through the command line and helping locate the layer in which a failure occurs. Temporary code produced during a client session is saved before formal acceptance; the run manifest binds file hashes and parameters. Later revisions can therefore be traced through a code difference and a new run identity to the original attempt.
claim.zh-CN: 研究源码与软件连接之间保留清晰边界，使模型能够通过命令行独立运行，也便于定位失败发生在哪一层。客户端会话中产生的临时代码在正式验收前写入文件；运行清单记录文件哈希和参数。由此，后续修订能够通过代码差异和新的运行身份追溯到原始尝试。

claim.en: A task submission specifies a case, parameter file, run identifier, and resource policy. A long task first returns its identifier and then persists status, logs, and results in its assigned directory. After a client timeout, the client queries that run rather than interpreting a communication failure as solver termination and starting another solve. Results retain both execution status and physical acceptance; cancellation, budget exhaustion, program exceptions, and lack of convergence retain their respective causes.
claim.zh-CN: 任务提交包含案例、参数文件、运行号和资源策略。长任务先返回运行号，再将状态、日志和结果持续写入所属目录。客户端连接超时后查询该运行的状态，避免将通信中断解释为求解器停止并重复启动。结果同时记录执行状态与物理验收状态；取消、预算耗尽、程序异常和未收敛分别保留其原因。

claim.en: The runner manages the process tree it creates and binds cancellation and cleanup to process creation identity. The project budget is eight logical processors, 24 GiB of task memory, and an 8 GiB system free-memory reserve. Student cases additionally obey their actual license constraints and request four solver cores. Resource records explain execution capacity and termination causes so that constrained runs can be interpreted separately from completed calculations. [@PSUTIL; @PYTHON]
claim.zh-CN: 运行器管理自己创建的进程树，依据进程创建身份实施取消和清理。项目预算为八个逻辑处理器、24 GiB 任务内存及 8 GiB 系统空闲内存；Student 案例另受其实际许可证限制，并请求四个求解器核。资源记录用于解释执行能力和中止原因，避免将受限运行与完整计算混在同一比较中。[@PSUTIL; @PYTHON]

claim.en: Recovery first checks the identities of the request, source snapshot, and checkpoint. Existing tutorial recovery reruns saved inputs under a linked new identifier; complete numerical routes use their own checkpoint protocols. Reconnecting a client, restarting a task, and restoring a numerical checkpoint have different meanings, which are retained in parent-task relationships and recovery descriptions.
claim.zh-CN: 接续前核对请求、源码快照和检查点身份。已有教程的恢复通过关联的新运行号重新执行保存输入；完整数值路线则按各自的检查点协议恢复。连接恢复、任务重启和数值检查点恢复具有不同含义，产物中的父任务关系与恢复说明保留这些差别。

claim.en: Physical conventions enter each execution interface through the common parameter file: SI units, exp(jωt), RMS phasors, copper at 20 °C, σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m, and μr=1. The principal transport condition is 200 kHz and 20 A RMS. Strands are insulated along their lengths and connected in parallel at their ends. Common terminal voltage and total current jointly determine complex strand currents through the augmented system below.
claim.zh-CN: 物理约定从统一参数文件进入各执行入口：SI 单位、exp(jωt)、RMS 相量、20 ℃ 铜、σ=5.8×10⁷ S/m 和 μr=1。主要输运工况为 200 kHz、20 A RMS。沿途绝缘的股线在端部并联，共同端电压与总电流共同确定逐股复电流，所对应的增广系统见下式。

Acceptance checks current constraints, power balance, and discretization sensitivity, together with return and boundary conditions. The 2 mm round wire in Q1 serves as an analytical calibration and has a DC current density of approximately 6.366 A/mm²; Q2 candidates require at least 5 mm² nominal copper area. Small-strand port cases validate interfaces and constraints, with their area conditions retained in the case description.
claim.zh-CN: 式中的 Z 为所选模型的耦合阻抗矩阵，e 为独立感应电压项，i 与 V 为待求复电流和端电压。验收检查电流约束、功率平衡与离散敏感性，并核对回流和边界。Q1 的 2 mm 圆线承担解析校准，其直流电流密度约为 6.366 A/mm²；Q2 候选要求至少 5 mm² 名义铜截面。小股数端口案例用于验证接口和约束，其面积条件随案例保留。

claim.en: ## Wolfram calibration and model extension
claim.zh-CN: ## Wolfram 校准与模型扩展

claim.en: The Wolfram case records MCP initialization, tool discovery, and actual calls, connecting analytical calculation, testing, graphics, and Notebook persistence. At 200 kHz, the round-wire reference gives Rac={{metric:q1_rac}} mΩ/m and a loss of {{metric:q1_loss}} W/m. Independent complex-current and Joule-power integrals check normalization and the RMS convention. The analytical reference and native Notebook tooling are supported by the mathematical definitions and the AgentTools interface, respectively. [@BESSEL; @AGENTTOOLS]
claim.zh-CN: Wolfram 案例记录 MCP 初始化、工具发现和实际调用，并将解析计算、测试、图形及 Notebook 保存连接起来。单圆线基准在 200 kHz 下给出 Rac={{metric:q1_rac}} mΩ/m、损耗 {{metric:q1_loss}} W/m；复电流积分与焦耳功率积分分别检验归一化及 RMS 约定。解析基准及原生 Notebook 的工具能力分别来自数学定义与 AgentTools 接口。[@BESSEL; @AGENTTOOLS]

claim.en: {{figure:q1_profile}}
claim.zh-CN: {{figure:q1_profile}}

claim.en: The frequency-extension case expands the single-frequency analytical implementation into a frequency study. It retains the source difference, parameters, and new results and checks integrals, the low-frequency limit, and regression against the original case. This example demonstrates how agent edits can enter the research workflow through deterministic checks. Its acceptance covers the analytical implementation and tested frequency conditions; adding material dispersion or thermal coupling would require corresponding physical checks.
claim.zh-CN: 频率扩展案例将单频解析实现扩展为频率研究，保存源码差异、参数和新运行结果，并检验积分、低频极限及原单频回归。该案例说明智能体修改可以通过确定性检查进入研究流程；其验收范围是解析实现及所测频率条件，后续增加材料频散或热耦合时需建立相应物理检查。

claim.en: ## Maxwell construction, solution, and comparison
claim.zh-CN: ## Maxwell 建模、求解与交叉比较

claim.en: The Ansys case connects MCP to a runner-owned session and completes material assignment, excitation, solution, and result retrieval for a small seven-strand Maxwell model. The rc2_maxwell_mcp_verified_01 run and its linked recovery pass checks within the port-and-power scope; protocol probes retain their own protocol status. Task cancellation and recovery under a new identifier have separate records, allowing the relationship between task identity and actual AEDT execution to be inspected.
claim.zh-CN: Ansys 案例从运行器所属会话连接进入 MCP，完成小型七股 Maxwell 模型的材料、激励、求解和结果回读。rc2_maxwell_mcp_verified_01 及关联恢复运行通过端口与功率范围内的检查；协议探针自身的结果保留为协议状态。任务取消和新运行恢复另有独立记录，因而可以检查从任务身份到实际 AEDT 执行的对应关系。

claim.en: The Wolfram–Maxwell comparison uses seven straight insulated strands, common terminal voltage, a total-current constraint, and a controlled copper return. Alignment checks cover strand count, polygonal cross-section, strand diameter, return inner and outer radii, exterior-domain radius, axial depth, frequency, and total current. The retained comparison gives a relative L2 difference of 0.0106814% in complex strand currents and a relative bundle Rac difference of 0.00132823%; the corresponding resistances are 318.290316 and 318.294544 mΩ per axial metre.
claim.zh-CN: Wolfram 与 Maxwell 比较采用直线绝缘七股、共同端电压、总电流约束及受控铜回流。对齐项目包括股数、多边形截面、股径、回流内外半径、外域半径、轴向深度、频率和总电流。保存比较中的逐股复电流相对 L2 差异为 0.0106814%，束内 Rac 相对差异为 0.00132823%；相应电阻为 318.290316 和 318.294544 mΩ/轴向m。

claim.en: These values describe agreement between implementations for this case. The implementations use independent meshes and interpolation orders, the conductor cross-sections are 42-sided polygons, and return segmentation may differ. Maxwell uses one adaptive pass, with spatial and boundary convergence still to be established. The case's copper area is below the Q2 requirement. The comparison therefore checks the common-port implementation across solvers; further accuracy estimation requires varying meshes and boundaries and analyzing the resulting changes.
claim.zh-CN: 这些数值描述该案例的跨实现一致程度。两套实现使用独立网格和插值阶次，导体截面为 42 边形，回流分段也可能不同；Maxwell 使用一次自适应求解，尚未建立空间和边界收敛。案例铜面积小于 Q2 要求。因此，比较结果作为共同端口实现的交叉核查，进一步的精度估计需改变网格与边界并分析结果变化。

claim.en: The failure-diagnosis case retains an actual unit-conversion API error and its repair. A transport response from an MCP call does not by itself establish successful application execution: a tool may return an error as an ordinary string while the protocol-level isError flag remains false. Diagnosis therefore examines the returned content, exception context, and expected result structure, corrects the API invocation, and checks the successful response and subsequent solver outputs in a new run.
claim.zh-CN: 失败诊断案例保留了一次实际单位换算 API 错误及其修复。原 MCP 调用的传输返回并不能单独代表业务执行成功：工具可能以普通字符串返回错误，而协议层 isError 仍为 false。诊断需要检查实际返回内容、异常上下文和预期结果结构，随后修正 API 调用，并在新运行中核对成功响应及后续求解产物。

claim.en: The repair preserves the original physical parameters and constraints. The failed call, revised call, and linked Maxwell result form a comparison that identifies the interface layer as the site of repair. The protocol report establishes whether the tool performed the intended operation; the physical report remains responsible for port and power acceptance. Run identities connect the two reports.
claim.zh-CN: 该修复保持原物理参数和约束。失败调用、修订后的调用与关联 Maxwell 结果构成对照，使读者能够识别修复发生在接口层。协议报告据此说明工具是否完成预期操作，物理报告则继续负责端口和功率验收；二者通过运行身份关联。

claim.en: The A–φ case illustrates a different diagnostic task. The executor reads existing field, potential, and derivative diagnostics and records completed execution while retaining the failed_retained_phi_gauge physical status. Changes to sampling or display parameters alter how the saved field is observed. The original field inputs, sample positions, diagnostic formulas, and acceptance thresholds jointly support interpretation; subsequent repair must address the numerical treatment of potential and gauge conditions. [@FEMDOC]
claim.zh-CN: A–φ 案例展示另一类诊断。执行器读取已有场、势和导数诊断，记录 completed 执行状态，同时保留 failed_retained_phi_gauge 物理状态。采样参数和显示参数的修改只改变保存场的观察方式。原场输入、采样位置、诊断公式与验收门槛共同决定解释依据，后续修订需要回到势与规范条件的数值实现。[@FEMDOC]

claim.en: {{figure:aphi_gates}}
claim.zh-CN: {{figure:aphi_gates}}

claim.en: The Wolfram tool record also includes process cleanup after frontend work completed: a save receipt was observed, the owned helper process ultimately exited with code 137, and the cleanup reason was retained separately. Interpreting such a run requires the completion receipt, saved outputs, and process-termination reason together. One exit code cannot fully describe work spanning a frontend and kernel.
claim.zh-CN: Wolfram 工具记录还包含前端工作完成后的进程清理：保存回执已确认，所属辅助进程最终退出码为 137，清理原因单独记录。分析这类运行时，需要同时读取完成回执、已保存产物和进程终止原因。单个退出码无法完整表达跨前端与内核的工作状态。

claim.en: Together, the six case classes cover calibration and Notebook production, native model construction and solution, cross-solver comparison, source extension, interface repair, and interpretation of numerical failure. Their common outputs are identifiable inputs, source, calls, results, and acceptance explanations. A successor can reproduce a problem at the relevant layer and continue the investigation under a new run identity.
claim.zh-CN: 六类案例共同覆盖校准与 Notebook、原生建模求解、跨求解器比较、源码扩展、接口修复及数值失败解释。其共同产物是可定位的输入、源码、调用、结果和验收说明。接手者可以选择具体失败层重现问题，并以新的运行身份继续研究。

claim.en: Reviewable automated research depends on a continuous association between tasks and evidence. Visible requests, tool events, source differences, and deterministic tests organize the execution records of the cases studied here. Scientific judgment still requires explicit model applicability, comparison quantities, and acceptance tolerances. Executable code, generated graphics, and typeset papers address software execution, result presentation, and document construction, respectively; acceptance steps connect these activities to physical reliability.
claim.zh-CN: 自动化研究的可复核性取决于任务与证据之间的连续关联。可见任务、工具事件、源码差异和确定性测试足以组织本文案例的执行记录；科学判断仍需要明确模型适用条件、比较量和验收容差。代码能够运行、图形能够生成和论文能够排版，分别对应软件执行、结果表达和文档构建，它们与物理可靠性通过验收步骤连接。

claim.en: The research process involves both editable and stable objects. Parameters, source, and follow-up tasks must remain easy to modify, while the inputs and results supporting conclusions are fixed by hashes. Versioned data directories preserve original file identities, and new runs use separate directories. Redrawn figures record their saved inputs and transformations. Bilingual manuscripts share equation, figure, and citation identities, allowing changes in presentation to be traced to the same scientific content.
claim.zh-CN: 研究过程同时涉及可编辑对象与稳定对象。参数、源码和后续研究任务需要便于修改；用于支撑结论的输入与结果则通过哈希固定。版本化数据目录保存原始文件身份，新运行写入独立目录。图件从保存数据重绘时记录来源与变换，双语稿件共享公式、图表和引用编号，使阅读层的变化可以追溯到同一科学内容。

claim.en: This workflow is particularly suitable for progressively richer modeling. Analytical and two-dimensional cases provide inexpensive regressions; small-strand models test common-terminal constraints; finite-length and three-dimensional routes introduce additional degrees of freedom. Native Notebooks allow readers to inspect viewpoints of three-dimensional geometry and saved fields. Actual centerlines retain strand identity, arc length, and local position as inputs for model extension. Structural performance comparisons also require matched copper volume, return, end regions, and numerical uncertainty.
claim.zh-CN: 这种流程特别适合逐层推进的模型研究。解析和二维案例提供低成本回归，少股模型检查共同端约束，有限长度及三维路线逐步引入新的自由度。原生 Notebook 允许读者检查三维几何及保存场的视角；真实中心线保留股线身份、弧长和局部位置，为后续模型扩展提供输入。结构性能比较还需匹配实际铜体积、回流、端区和数值不确定性。

claim.en: {{figure:geometry_comparison}}
claim.zh-CN: {{figure:geometry_comparison}}

claim.en: This work provides workflows, connection configurations, execution adapters, model source, and traceable cases. The existing records support Codex completing specified modeling tasks through Wolfram and Ansys MCP, extending an analytical implementation, and repairing an interface using error evidence.
